blocks.html:
HYUNDAI VELOSTER 2016 FULL CAR WRAP WITH SATIN PURPLE

Clients requesting a full car wrap is a norm for most vehicle wrap agencies. What’s different about each request is the client’s vision, creativity and reason which inspires them to get a full car wrap. And the reason could be anything. We realize everyone is their own human being with unique tastes and preferences for things that they find interesting.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, getting the opportunity to meet and work with these creative people who want to manifest their imagination onto their vehicles, is one of the driving forces for us. Wrapping cars is an art and if there’s anything an artist appreciates, it’s the chance to work with other artistic and creative individuals. Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’re ready with open gates to take on a job that pushes us to our artistic limits.

Recently, Vinyl Wrap Toronto received a request from a lady who wanted a full car wrap for her Hyundai Veloster 2016. As we’ve mentioned above, the reason for getting a wrap varies from one individual to another. For this lady, the reasons that convinced her for getting a full car wrap for her Hyundai Veloster 2016 are as follows:

  • Switch to a more unique colour: Another reason why this lady decided to get a full car wrap is that she wanted to freshen up the colour of her Hyundai Veloster 2016. From the old factory Blue colour to something a bit more unique and edgy, something that she finds interesting, which was a Satin Purple. Now that’s an interesting choice of colour and finish. It takes courage and confidence to rock a colour like that out in public. As always, our team was thrilled to work on this project. Throughout the process, we communicated with the client about any modifications or directions. The final result was breathtaking! The car looked absolutely gorgeous with the vibrant Satin Purple Vinyl Wrap. Even our installers couldn’t take their eyes off of this beauty once it was finished being wrapped. We admire this lady’s unique and interesting sense of style and we’re sure she’s turning heads and filling hearts with envy.
  • Level of customizability: One of the key reasons for people to be opting for vinyl vehicle wraps as opposed to any other alternatives is the greater level of customizability. From a large spectrum of colours to choose from to have your favourite graphics printed on Vinyl, the possibilities are endless. This lady was aware of it, she wanted to give a makeover to her Hyundai Veloster 2016 and so she got it. She wanted the original badges back on top of the vinyl wrap to give her car a more realistic and factory look, and our team gave her exactly what she asked for. Here’s our list of the top 5 car wraps where people brought their fantasies to life.

So, all the above-mentioned reasons convinced this lady to get her Hyundai Veloster 2016 wrapped with a gorgeous Satin Purple Vinyl Wrap. Our team enjoyed working on this unique project thoroughly and we appreciate that we get the chance to work with creative individuals like herself.

Additionally, there was a request made by her which we ended up not doing not because it was impossible but simply because it was not worth it, considering the additional cost and durability. She asked our team to get the interior of her Hyundai Veloster 2016 wrapped as well. Our installers are more than qualified to wrap anything but we advised her otherwise because some surfaces are not worth wrapping due to their inability to hold the vinyl wrap.

So, instead of making a quick buck and giving her what she asked for we gave her advice that was in her best interest and she appreciated that and decided to go according to our suggestions. So in order to make our clients be aware of the effects of some of the things they ask for we give them the best advice and from that moment they call the shots on whether they want to go for it or not. For us, it’s all about customer satisfaction.

Since we’re on the subject of colour change, it’s better to be aware of your options. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto we use only quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M. The reason we only use these materials is that they’re the industry leaders that offer the best quality, colour options and finish options as compared to any other brands on the market.

So, you can go wild with your imagination when getting a vinyl wrap. Anything you can think of can be printed on vinyl and installed on your vehicle. These materials offer a huge range of colours to choose from as well as various finishing styles such as Satin, Matte, Gloss, Brushed etc.

In this lady’s case, she picked the colour purple with a satin finish. So about the Satin finish, our installers believe the customers who are thinking of getting a vehicle wrap, should know that wraps done in a certain finish and colour have natural colour change properties which makes the colour appear slightly different when viewed from certain lighting and angle.

So, if that’s a deal-breaker for you, you might want to consider a different colour that does not have natural colour shift characteristics like the carbon fibre finish. Another reason why people choose a satin finish is that it is easy to look after as compared to matte & gloss finishes.

Check out our blog post about the benefits of vehicle wraps here.

We encourage our potential clients to get in touch with us regarding any queries or for getting a quote. Please feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or if you’d like to visit, we’re located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4, we’d be glad to answer your queries regarding car wrap cost, vinyl materials, etc. Check out more car wraps here.

PORSCHE MACAN FULL CAR WRAP BY VINYL WRAP TORONTO

One of the perks of owning a Vinyl Wrap business is the opportunity to experiment with different designs and techniques on your own vehicle. That’s exactly what Paolo; owner of Vinyl Wrap Toronto did. According to him, if it’s good enough for him, it’s good enough for our customers. And if the owner of the business has it done on his own vehicle, that’s saying a lot about the authenticity of Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

As we all know, inspiration can strike from anywhere. For Paolo, it was a picture of another vehicle that led him to end up with a gorgeous masterpiece on his Porsche Macan 2016. Like everyone else, after a while, he felt his Porsche needed an upgrade. Paolo has always appreciated patterns and colours that reflect creativity, and that’s what the output represented.

The picture he saw online was of a vehicle wrapped with a certain pattern and colour. So, he wanted something similar, but with his own personal touch to it. Being a man of a free and open mind, Paolo likes to express himself. In this case, his Porsche Macan 2016 became his canvas.

His idea was to get a full car wrap with eye-catching colours blended in a smooth gradient, adding an underlay to create an embossed feel and to complement all that. He also wanted to add an overlay of a unique floral and wavey pattern in white vinyl. As you can see from the images featured on this page, his Porsche Macan 2016 went from a plain old black to an exciting and colourful work of art.

The process started with our designers, rendering Paolo’s vision onto a digital mock-up. This may sound easy, but it’s far from that. Every design request is different and it requires a creative and capable mind to mirror a client’s ideas into a digital file. Fortunately for our customers, Vinyl Wrap Toronto has a team of professional graphic designers with an interest and mastery in what they do. Our designers and Paolo communicated back and forth to get the design right. We believe communication is the key.

EXPECTATIONS VS REALITY:

Although our designers can render any graphic that you can think of, yet sometimes it does not always turn out the way you want it to look. For example, in Paolo’s case. Initially, he wanted a wrap that featured 3 colours namely Orange, Yellow and Blue. It seemed like a good idea in his head, but when he saw what it would look like on the digital mock-up of his Porsche Macan 2016, he realized it needs to change as the fading colours meant that the blue and yellow mix makes green.

He did not feel this was a good choice. So, eventually, with his team of creative designers, he decided on an improved design featuring colours that complemented each other. This was a great example which showed our team’s coordination and advice with our customers’ best interests in mind.

Apart from getting a full car wrap for his Porsche Macan 2016, it was a great opportunity for him, as a customer, to see how smooth and organized his own company’s process is.

As soon as the design was approved, there’s a series of standard steps that every wrap job goes through. The steps are as follows:

  • Printing and Lamination: After the design was approved, we started printing it onto large sheets of Vinyl. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we use industry-standard printing equipment that prints with complete accuracy and precision. The colours you see on the screen are the exact same colours you get on your vehicle. Depending on the patterns, size and layers of the design, the time taken to print can vary.
  • Cutting: Once it was done with lamination, the next thing on the list is to cut the vinyl. Depending on the complexity of the patterns, the time taken to cut them out varies from pattern to pattern. The machines we use to cut the vinyl, have absolute precision. In this case, since the design is pattern rich, our equipment handled it impressively well. The pattern, as always came out looking super detailed and sharp.
  • Installation: After it was cut and weeded. It was passed on to our installation team. This is the real deal. No more playing around with designs on computers that you can change anytime. This in-house job tested our installation team. It involved 3 layers. The first layer acted as the underlay to create an embossed pattern. The second layer with a gradient of yellow to orange wrap the whole car and the third layer of white coloured vinyl cut out in an attractive floral and wavey pattern along with our company’s logo on several locations on the Porsche Macan. For inexperienced installers, that would have been enough to make them weep, but installers working at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have more than a decade of experience. So, if anything it was an interesting opportunity to show off their skills. And it proved itself exactly that. In order to wrap Paolo’s Porsche Macan 2016, our installers had to disassemble most of its parts in order to wrap them with care and perfection. But it was all worth it when we saw the finished product. Our installers take their jobs seriously and treat the vehicles with the utmost care; whether it is a truck or a car, we see them all as equally valuable.

Apart from using the best equipment and installation team to wrap the vehicles, we use the top-quality material available on the market. We only use quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M. The reason is their wide range of colour options and the ability to last for years before surrendering to mother nature. All-in-all Vinyl Wrap Toronto does not compromise with quality.

Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’re always looking for opportunities to do something out of the box and our list of things to wrap is never-ending. Since we’re on the subject of Porsches, our team would love to get the opportunity to wrap up the Porsche GT3s in the future.

Check out our post about the benefits of getting a vinyl wrap here.

If you wish to give your car a fresh new look, please feel free to contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to see us in action. Check out more car wraps here.

blocks.html:
VINYL WRAP TORONTO’S LIST OF INTERESTING OBJECT WRAPS

When we say we can wrap anything, we’re not kidding and our customers know it. Although Vinyl Wrap Toronto is a vehicle wrap agency, we like to dabble into wrapping all kinds of objects. Objects that are priceless to our customers, objects they intend to gift, objects they want to customize, etc. Every now and then we receive a request from a customer asking us to wrap something that would be considered unusual for an agency that wraps vehicles. We appreciate our customers greatly, who deem us qualified to wrap their personal objects and we do the job with perfection to assure them that they made the right decision.

Now, when it comes to objects, we all know there could be countless objects or equipment. What people choose to get wrapped is their personal choice and we respect that. It gives us immense pleasure to get the opportunity to wrap these objects and equipment. Every request we get for wrapping an object is another opportunity for us to learn and expand our skillset. Our installers are always looking for interesting wraps to do. Being able to make a customer happy is what keeps us going and trying new things.

Speaking of objects, today we’re listing down some of the most interesting object wrap requests we received from our clients.

  • An Urn: Yes, you read that right. One of our creative customers asked us to wrap an Urn. The customer had recently experienced a loss of a loved one and they wanted to do something special with the urn that was going to be holding that loved one forever. The customer wanted to wrap the urn with something sentimental to express their love towards the loved one who just moved on. We think it was a beautiful gesture and we took the job with an open heart. The customer was incredibly pleased to get the urn wrapped exactly as they envisioned. Everyone can agree that being able to soothe the pain of a grieving soul is something that makes us connect on a deeper human level. Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we appreciate that our customers think of us to do something so touching and personal.
  • A Murphy Bed: Now that’s something you don’t see every day, a wrapped murphy bed. Although Murphy beds are supposed to be saving space, and they do it very well, yet you can’t help but notice a big thing stuck to your wall. Most people won’t be bothered by it but some who pay attention to detail would find a creative way to make it seem natural. That’s exactly what this customer wanted. They had a few bookshelves at their place and a Murphy bed. They believed the murphy bed looked a bit odd, so they wanted it to blend in with the rest of the interior. So, this customer had an idea that they want to wrap the bottom of the Murphy Bed with a wrap that looks like a bookshelf. It was a brilliant idea. Without a doubt, we took the job and made her vision come true. After the wrap, the bed blended in perfectly.
  • High Heel Shoes: Oftentimes, when people are going out with their squad in a party mode, personalizing their heels is the last thing on their minds. However, it does not mean you can’t be creative. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has proved that we can wrap objects even as small as a pair of heels. Who knew you could use the real estate on your heels to express yourself? This was one of those creative ideas that we couldn’t refuse.
  • Wifi Boxes: Are you trying to camouflage or blend an object into the background? We wrapped wifi boxes that were being installed at the Distillery District. The client did not want the boxes which were being placed on the outside of buildings to be an eyesore. The company supplied us with the paint colour of the buildings and we colour-matched and then wrapped the wifi boxes. Now unless you look for the boxes, they should be nearly invisible.
  • Stove Hood Air Vent: When you know you’re going to be spending a significant amount in your kitchen, it’s natural to want to personalize it with what pleases your eye. A client wanted to get their Stove Hood Air Vent wrapped in black to complement their kitchen interior. So, instead of paying a lot for it, they decided to get a wrap would be a far better choice, considering the lifetime, price, and ability to change back. This is the kind of outside-the-box thinking we love to be a part of.
  • Guitar: Got a guitar sitting in your room that could use a bit of vinyl goodness? We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto are here to make that happen. Recently a customer came to us with a guitar that they thought looked dull and boring. So, they wanted to give it a personal touch by getting their favourite cartoon character on it. It was a character named “Blinky” from the popular animated TV show, ”The Simpsons”. It was an interesting choice and certainly made the guitar more vibrant and appealing.
  • Mackbook Pro: A computer is something that people end up using very often if not every day. For some people, it does not matter what the back of their laptop looks like. However, not everyone is the same and some may want to personalize it with their favorite graphic. Often times we get requested by our customers to wrap their laptops and we take on the job with an open mind. The choice of graphics and design varies from customer to customer. Vinyl Wrap Toronto appreciates getting the chance to be able to provide our customers with what makes them happy.
  • Scooter: With time people are getting to the realization that if there’s anything that gives full freedom to go wild with their imagination, it’s a vinyl wrap job. The possibilities are endless. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’ve wrapped scooters for our clients. It is not as common for people to get their scooter wrapped, but when we get asked for it, we make sure we say a big yes and do a terrific job.

So, those were some of the most interesting objects we’ve wrapped at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. The objects no vehicle wrap agency usually gets into. Either because of their inexperience or some other reason. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we like to give it our best shot before we give up on something. And almost every time, we have outdone ourselves with the new challenges we receive. Vinyl Wrap Toronto encourages people to contact us for any kind of object wrap. Experts here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto would love to discuss your requirements and make it happen for you.

Check out some of the benefits of getting a vehicle wrap here.

Read: Object Wrap; Personalize your everyday objects with a design of your choice.

We mean it when we say we can wrap anything that has a smooth surface. It could be anything such as vending machines, toolboxes, house walls, etc. If you have something close to you that could use a personal touch of your own, feel free to contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to speak to our expert designers and make your vision come to life. blocks.html:
TRUCK DECALS – HINO 258 2019 BY VINYL WRAP TORONTO

Decals are variable-sized vinyl stickers that stick to the surface of your vehicle. Decals are a great way to express something through your vehicle. Whether it is a personal graphic or a graphic solely for the purpose of advertising your brand. The beauty of decals is that you can get any graphic in the form of decals at a very reasonable price. From reflective Vinyl to printable Vinyl decals, there’s a lot to choose from.

Recently Vinyl Wrap Toronto installed vehicle decals for the Canadian Automobile Association (CAA) on their Hino 258 – 2019. CAA is one of our regular clients. Over the years we’ve been installing decals and wraps on their company trucks. Professionals working at CAA are aware of the power of vehicle decals.

When it comes to non-aggressive and cost-effective advertising, decals are a way to go. Your vehicle becomes a moving billboard. CAA brought their Hino 258 – 2019 for truck decals because they know how to use an opportunity to push their brand.

Since trucks are large vehicles, it is almost impossible for people to ignore a truck passing by and because of their ability to catch people’s attention, it is a brilliant idea to promote a business through all that real estate available on trucks.

Installers working at Vinyl Wrap Toronto installed decals on the CAA’s Hino 258 – 2019 with the utmost care and precision. Our process is simple and transparent. The clients contact us explaining what it is that they’re looking for. Our team listens to the clients and generates a digital mock-up based on a client’s input. A digital mock-up is basically a way to show what the decals or a vehicle wrap would look like on their vehicle before we actually do it.

Once the client is happy with the design and approves it, our professional installers start to convert that digital mock-up into reality. Over the years we’ve had a 100% client satisfaction rate in terms of service, precision, and quality. We’ve featured some pictures of the decals we installed on CAA’s truck Hino 258 – 2019 on this page for you to see.

Since we’re on the topic of vehicle decals, here are some benefits they offer when compared to any other vehicle wrap jobs.

  • Freedom of Imagination: The best thing about decals, there is no set standard size or shape for them. Decals could be of any size and shape. All you have to do is imagine and you’ll see that your vision has been turned into a physical sticker that sticks onto your vehicle. There are a ton of colour and finish options to choose from. Whether you want reflective decals or custom-printed decals, there’s something for everyone. Decals have the power to change the overall look of your truck, van, or car. It can either be a personal graphic or your company logo, you can rest assured knowing it is being noticed by people around you. We see standard vehicles every day and we’ve subconsciously learned to not pay attention to them but every now and then when there are stickers/decals on the vehicle, due to our human nature, we can’t help but look and try to figure out what it says.
  • Quick Installation: Unlike full or partial vehicle wraps, decals are incredibly easy and quick to install. So, if you’re in a rush to promote your brand or give your vehicle a personal touch, vehicle decals are the way to go. However, it is still very important that you get the decals done by someone who knows what they’re doing. Like the installers working at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, with their experience working in the industry for more than a decade, you can relax knowing the decals will turn out looking perfect.
  • Cost-effective: Since there is a lot less effort, material, and time involved in installing vehicles on trucks, vans, and cars as compared to a full wrap or a partial wrap, it goes without saying that the cost would be relatively low. So, if you’re looking to upgrade your vehicle on a budget, decals are your best option.
  • Super Easy Maintenance: The beauty of getting decals is that they’re incredibly low maintenance. You can practically forget about them once you get them done. With the least amount of care, you will see the decals will last for years.

Despite having all the above-mentioned benefits, there is something our installers will tell you which will help you make your decision. It is that when you get decals on your truck or car, the decals will protect the paint under them from the sun and environmental damage while the paint on the rest of the vehicle will be affected by those things.

This will result in your vehicle’s paint fading over time. Years later, when you finally decide to take off the decals, you will see that the paint under the decals hasn’t aged a bit while the paint around them has and that will leave a visible tan line on your vehicle. Speak to our installers about options to reduce the tan lines.

Read: How to use the real estate on your fleet to promote your business.

To help you make a better decision, check out our blog about the benefits of a vehicle wrap here.

If you’re considering getting decals on your truck, van, car, motorcycle, or basically anything that has a smooth surface, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON M9W 1B4 to speak with one of our experts. To check out more truck decals, click here.

blocks.html:
PERSONAL TRAILER WRAP BY VINYL WRAP TORONTO

Over the years Vinyl Wrap Toronto has seen a trend, that people generally tend to get commercial wraps for big vehicles, but every now and then we get the opportunity to work with a creative client who wants to get a personal wrap. We recently got to work with a very special client who had a unique and creative vision in mind and we turned it into reality. That special person who brought us this very interesting personal partial trailer wrap job is Mr. Moussa Tahlil.

Upon interacting with Mr. Moussa Tahlil we were immediately impressed by the man’s creative vision, his zeal for racing and his love for his family. He makes it very clear that life is for the living and we might as well do everything that gives us pleasure while we have the time. We believe we all should live by that lifestyle. This was the first time ever that Vinyl Wrap Toronto received an interesting request like this.

The beauty of personal wraps is that they are solely based on the client’s vision. There is little to no interference from a designer. It’s a client’s way to express themselves through their imagination. One of the perks of getting a vehicle wrap is that there are no limitations; anything that you can imagine can be printed and installed on your vehicle. In this particular case, Mr. Moussa Tahlil had it all envisioned.

It was totally unique to us and we were thrilled to get the opportunity to make it happen. Mr. Tahlil is very passionate about racing and has a great love for his family. He wanted to make a statement while showcasing his enthusiasm and love.

This partial wrap is an enlarged image on the trailer’s backdoor that shows what the inside of the trailer looks like. The image features Mr. Tahlil’s two loves, his sports car parked inside the trailer and his adorable son sitting beside the car with a precious smile on his face. This image holds great value to him so he wanted everyone to see it. The trailer wrap looks so realistic that it will be hard for anyone to tell whether it is an image or reality. It is a very unique way to give people a realistic view of what’s inside the trailer.

Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we greatly appreciate the creative vision of our clients and are always looking to put a smile on their faces by turning their dreams into reality. We encourage unique ideas like these and take great pleasure in doing these jobs.

Since we’re on the topic of personal vehicle wraps, below are some of the things you should know about vehicle wraps that will help you make a decision:

WHY GET VEHICLE WRAPS:

  1. Make a Statement: In most cases, people end up with the same factory standard vehicle as others who have the same vehicle. If you’re not passionate about cars, this may not be a problem for you but for someone who is quite attached to their car, it is lacking something. It is a personal touch that makes it one of a kind. So, if you’re looking to make a statement, turn heads and fill hearts with envy wherever your car or truck goes, a vehicle wrap is for you.
  2. Limitless Possibilities: Quite often when people want to customize their vehicle they’re restricted from getting certain patterns or things simply because they’re not possible. But in the case of Vinyl Wraps, you can literally think of any graphic or design that you want to get on your vehicle. All you have to do is imagine and we’ll make it happen.
  3. Variety of Options: Vinyl Wraps offer a huge range of options to choose from. The colour, the finish of the material, the type of wrap, there’s something for everyone. We use Avery Dennison & 3M to wrap vehicles. This is because of their premium quality and variations.
  4. Maintenance: Whether it is a personal wrap or commercial wrap, the thing you’d be least concerned about is maintaining it. Once done, it requires the least amount of effort to keep the wrap good enough to last for years to come.
  5. Upgrade the Vehicle: When you’ve been driving the same vehicle for years, it is natural for it to lose its new car feeling and become dull. In a situation like that, one of the most cost-effective ways to upgrade your vehicle is to get a vinyl wrap. From a complete colour change to adding a few decals like racing stripes, the choice is all yours depending on your needs.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have expert installers who take their job seriously and do it with pleasure. We are always looking for a challenge that tests our limits and polishes our skills. Professionals working at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have a special place for empathy in their hearts which makes them connect with customers on a deeper human level. We believe it is extremely necessary for people to be comfortable talking and sharing their vision, especially for something like a vehicle wrap because that thing will be on the vehicle for a significant amount of time.

If you wish to learn more about the benefits of vehicle wraps, check out our blog post here.

Feel free to reach out to us for any of your vehicle wrap queries. Our contact number is 416-746-1381 or if you would like to visit our garage, we’re located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4. We would love to have you over and talk to one of our experts. Check out more trailer wraps here.

blocks.html:
INFINITI FX50 CARBON FIBRE PARTIAL CAR WRAP – VINYL WRAP TORONTO

Vinyl Wraps are amazing; we can’t say it enough. A thin layer of a vinyl sheet can give your vehicle the look you always wanted without breaking the bank. Vinyl Wraps offer you a wide spectrum of colours and finishes to choose from. So, it’s safe to say there’s something for everyone. One of our customers wanted to get a vinyl wrap for their Infiniti FX50. The fact that he had an Infiniti FX50 shows he had a great taste in cars and on top of that he wanted to polish the look of his Infiniti FX50 to make it stand out among all others who have the same car.

Since vinyl comes in various finishes and colours, this customer had a very specific request. The customer wanted to wrap the hood, roof and back of his Infiniti FX50 with Black Carbon Fiber Vinyl. A great choice indeed. Carbon Fiber is one of the most popular finishes that Vinyl Wraps come in. As it’s clear from the name, it gives off the look and feel of actual carbon fibre minus the cost.

Getting real carbon fibre on a vehicle is not very ideal, due to the fact that it costs a lot. So, the simplest and most cost-effective alternative is to get a vinyl wrap with a carbon fibre finish. The look of Carbon Fibre wrap is indistinguishable from that of real carbon fibre. Not only does it look like real carbon fibre, but it also has a texture that makes the experience even more authentic and less gimmicky.

Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we are always looking to do such interesting jobs. We believe we get to work with customers with very active imaginations and great taste. We have attached some images of the Infiniti FX50 on this page for you to see how much of a difference getting a vehicle wrap can make. The addition of Black Carbon Fibre Vinyl Wrap on the hood, roof and back certainly makes the Infiniti FX50 look a lot edgier and more premium.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we use the best quality material available on the market, because we understand. When it comes to wrapping something as personal as a client’s vehicle, there are to be no compromises with the quality.

Update: The client came back and got the sides of the windows covered in the same Carbon Fibre, making the car look even cooler.

We only use vinyl wrap material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M because they offer a great variety of colour options, and various finish options along the premium quality that makes the vinyl wrap last for years. Now, just because there’s quality material doesn’t mean you can’t go wrong. It takes expert installers to actually take that premium quality material and install it on a vehicle with perfection so that it doesn’t have any improper cuts, bubbles, etc.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto we have a team of experienced installers who have more than a decade of experience wrapping all kinds of vehicles and equipment. So, you can rest assured knowing your vehicle will be in capable hands and will come out looking just as you had envisioned. The owner of the Infiniti FX50 will testify to that.

Below is a list of some of the perks that vinyl wraps offer:

  • Easy to install and remove (Professionally).
  • Vinyl Wrap protects your vehicle from UV rays, Scratches & road Debris.
  • Vinyl Wraps offer a great level of customizability such as colours, and finishes and allow you to custom print whatever you want on them.
  • Vehicle wraps are easy to maintain, and the aftercare is minimal.
  • Vinyl Wraps last for 6-7 years.
  • For more benefits of getting a vehicle wrap, check our blog post here.

Quite often, the reason why people decide to get a vinyl wrap is that people are aware that they’re not the only ones who have that vehicle and they want to own something unique and special. Since there are a lot of people out there having the same factory standard vehicle as others, it sort of kills the pride of owning something one of a kind. Besides that, companies usually design cars using the general design language which is very minimal and would be accepted by most of the target customers.

However, everyone has a unique vision and taste and one standard look of a vehicle can’t satisfy everyone; at least not to the level where it becomes a pride to own it.

When you find yourself in that situation, where you wish to give your ride a personal touch of your own. You’d see the market has a lot of alternatives that allow you to customize your vehicle to your liking. The choice you make depends entirely on what you expect to accomplish and things like lifespan, colour options, finish options, maintenance, rollback, etc.

When all you want to do is, change the colour of your vehicle, or add a personal graphic or logo onto your vehicle, vinyl wrap is the way to go. Technically, you could also go for a custom paint job but you may want to read our blog post where we’ve explained why a vinyl wrap is better than getting a paint job, here. Check out more car wraps here.

If you wish to give your vehicle your personal touch and make it pop, call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to speak to one of our installers for a quote.

blocks.html:
PERSONAL VEHICLE DECALS FOR FORD F100

In a world where everyone has a car, it is almost impossible to have a car that no one else does unless you’re wealthy enough to get one made just for you. Car companies usually design cars and offer colour options that they believe are acceptable to most of the general public.

So, naturally what happens is a lot of people end up buying the same model and colour of the car. And it is not a surprise if you see a lot of cars just like yours. With all that happening, it’s completely normal for a person to feel as if the car they have is not quite special enough to pull people’s focus. This feeling is enough to make anyone restless, especially people who are passionate about their cars or vehicles. Vehicle decals can be a great way to express yourself and make your vehicle one of a kind.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto recently received a request from a customer asking for personal decals for his Ford F100 Truck. The customer has had the Ford F100 for a long time and he felt it was time to restore the original look of his Ford F100. This decals job happened, just because the owner of the Ford F100 wanted to return to the factory finish. What he wanted was to install decals on the sides to match the wooden accent on the back of his Ford F100, which he had done earlier.

Although to someone who is not interested in cars/vehicles, it may seem like an odd request seeing that it doesn’t change much of the overall look yet it made total sense to the client who wanted it and that’s all that matters. To him, it made all the sense in the world and after we were done installing the decals, the client left with a big smile on his face. The freedom to get almost anything on a vehicle truly allows you to go wild with your imagination. And that’s exactly what this customer did.

Another thing about people who get decals for their vehicles is that most of the time they know exactly what they want to see on their vehicle. It requires little to no ideas from other people. We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have noticed that customers who want to get personal decals are some of the most creative people out there and we’re grateful that we get the chance to make their visions come to life.

Almost every day we communicate with people wanting personal graphics for their vehicles, coming up with one great idea after another. The ever-changing nature of these personal wrap requests pushes us to our boundaries and allows us to learn new things and ultimately polishes our vehicle wrapping skillset.

All this customer wanted was to install very minimal decals on the sides of his Ford F100 truck to make it stand out. If that shows anything, it is that it doesn’t matter how small of customization it is, sometimes all that matters is the inner satisfaction. We did the job with perfection and the customer left fully satisfied with the results. We’ve attached some pictures of the final product on this page for you to look at.

Since we’re on the subject of vehicle decals, let’s dive into some of the most frequently asked questions people have about decals:

What are vehicle decals?

Vehicle Decals are variable-sized vinyl stickers cut out in a specified shape and design. They’re installed directly onto a vehicle’s surface.

Why do people get vehicle decals?

The reason to get vehicle decals could be anything. It could be personal, where you just want to customize your vehicle with your personal touch by getting decals of your favourite graphics, logos, quotes, etc or it could be commercial, where you want to advertise your business or your brand through your vehicle. If you wish to read more about how you can promote your business using vehicle decals, check out our blog post here.

How much do vehicle decals cost?

The answer to this question depends entirely on the size and number of decals you want to get installed. Call us at 416-822-3232 for a quote.

How long do vehicle decals last?

Once installed, decals can last up to 6-7 years with minimal aftercare. However, there are some tips our installers will give you that will help you maintain your decals for an even longer period.

Are vehicle decals easy to maintain?

Decals require the least amount of care compared to partial and full wraps after they’ve been installed.

Can I get anything turned into a decal?

The answer is yes, as long as it’s possible to design what you want, you can get anything as a decal in any size.

How long does it take to install or remove vehicle decals?

The installation and removal process of decals is incredibly easy as opposed to full & partial wrap jobs. Most of the time you can get the decals installed in a few hours after being printed and the same goes while removing them.

What are my options?

When it comes to decals, not only do you get the freedom to have anything turned into decals but you also get to choose from a variety of colour options and finishes such as matte, carbon fibre, gloss, etc.

What material do we use for decals?

We only use quality materials offered by Avery Dennison & 3M due to their premium quality, durability, great colour options, and various finish options.

Can I Install Decals myself?

Unless you’re a professional installer who has enough experience, we’d advise against trying to install them by yourself.

Read 5 Questions You Should Ask a Vinyl Wrap Company

If you have a question that hasn’t been addressed or would like to get a quote, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4. Check out more truck decals here.

blocks.html:
CUSTOM FULL WRAP FOR SMART CAR FORTWO

It is not very often to see a car that truly takes uniqueness to the next level. Especially when you come across hundreds of cars on an everyday basis. It becomes a challenge to make your car unique and attractive for both you and the people looking at it. We recently did a full wrap for a Smart Car Fortwo that belongs to one of our installers.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we like to push our boundaries and this is the perfect example. And instead of experimenting with anything on our clients’ vehicles, we first give it a go on vehicles that belong to us or the people working with us. We make sure that our clients get the best service possible and before we start offering it, we practice on our own cars.

Although our installers have more than a decade of experience, there are always new things to learn and try. We attempted to do something that we’d never done before. There are always things we haven’t tried and in the case of our installer, he had never tried printing anything on coloured material. He wanted to take a chance and worked out better than expected.

Our installer who owns the Smart Car Fortwo had a few reasons to get a full wrap for it, we’ve listed those reasons below:

  • Wanted a car that’s one of a kind: Like everyone who decides to get a full wrap for their vehicle to personalize it, our installer wanted the same. She felt that her Smart Car needed to pop; make a statement wherever it goes.
  • Experiment: Another reason why our installer wanted the full wrap was that she wanted an opportunity to experiment with a lot of things on her Smart Car before our installers try to do any of that on our actual clients’ vehicles. This Smart Car became a canvas for our artists (Installers & Graphic Designers).

With those two reasons in mind, it was time to come up with something that’ll make jaws drop. Being creative and innovative, it didn’t take long for our team to come up with an edgy and stylish design. The installer who owns the Smart Car wanted a pattern with roses on it and another installer wanted a skull with a beard and both of them wanted an edgy version of the logo of Vinyl Wrap Toronto on it. One of the reasons for this wrap was to promote our business.

That was enough to get the wheels rolling. Our team of skilled designers rendered the design on a digital file. From the point of deciding on a design, we started to manifest it into reality.

The next step was to print the design onto a Vinyl Sheet. Now the cool thing we did here was that we actually printed our design on a 3M psychedelic-coloured Vinyl. Usually, the coloured Vinyl is wrapped as is on the vehicle, but we had to try it and wanted to create something breathtakingly beautiful. So we decided to print on Vinyl which is generally considered non-printable and the results were worth the try. We came up with something completely out of the box.

Now the plain psychedelic vinyl which shifts colours like a rainbow from different viewing angles under sunlight had a black pattern printed on top of it.

At first, it may have seemed like an odd idea to us to put skulls having beards with a bunch of roses, but when we saw it printed on the Vinyl, it made all the sense in the world. This is a great example of how in the wrap industry, expectations can differ greatly from reality.

There are a few extra steps we took to make this work are:

  • We took standard coloured Vinyl and printed our design on it.
  • To protect the material from UV rays, we laminated it.
  • Printed on Chrome by Avery Dennison: Generally, it is not printed on due to the fact that it’s extremely fragile, but we had to give it a shot and it turned out perfect. Adding more grace to the Smart Car’s full wrap.

This whole full wrap for the Smart Car was nothing more than a test case, for us to see how far we can push the boundaries and that’s exactly what we did. Before, during and after doing it, there were a few questions that we had for ourselves:

  • Can we do it?
  • Will it last?
  • Does it look like it was worth it?

All those questions we had about the Smart Car’s full wrap, were answered when we decided to take the car to a car show. It was the perfect place to test what we had just accomplished. If there’s a place filled with wrap and car enthusiasts, it’s a car show.

When our installer drove the Smart Car into the Car show, Jaws dropped, heads turned and the crowd started passing fascinated looks. It was a moment of the result when we’d get to know whether the efforts we put into doing a full wrap for the Smart Car paid off or not. After a few moments, we found out the jaws that dropped and all the whispering was about how great the car looks. People were stunned by the Smart Car’s beauty.

The two-seater customized Smart Car stole the thunder from standard-looking luxury and sports cars at the car show. People came up to us and mentioned it was something that they had never seen before and expressed an interest in where they could get it done.

So, there you have it. The Story of a dull Smart Car that we turned into a stunning beauty. We’ve attached some pictures of the fully wrapped smart car on this page for you to admire.

Now that we have tested our abilities, we can confidently say we’re more than capable of doing a similar job for any other vehicle.

For interesting blogs about vehicle wraps, check out our blogs, here.

Also, check out our list of the top 5 personal car wraps.

If you wish to give your car a fresh new look, please feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 for a quote. Check out more car wraps here.

DODGE GRAND CARAVAN PROMOTIONAL VEHICLE DECALS

When it comes to advertising there are countless ways you can promote a business or brand. In most cases, people tend to go for online advertising which has been proven to be a bit aggressive and less effective as compared to the other ways to push a brand or a product. Among all the available alternatives to reach a wider audience, there is one that hides in plain sight and only a few people are aware of its non-aggressiveness and value for the money. That non-aggressive yet extremely effective way of advertising is Vehicle Decals. As opposed to digital advertising, vehicle decals have the potential to last for years and reach a much wider audience.

As people are getting aware of this great way to advertise, we at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have been receiving a lot of requests for vehicle decals. Recently we installed promotional decals on an existing client’s Dodge Grand Caravan 2011. The client had worked with us in the past when we did a partial wrap for his Mercedes Sprinter. At that time, it was a wrap intended for promotional purposes as well. This time, the client wanted to use all the available real estate on his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011 to promote his brand.

The customer owns a business named ‘KCS Group Ltd. Certified Electrical Contractor’. As the name suggests, the business is all about going to someone’s house or business location to provide a service. So, it was a brilliant idea to get vehicle decals because the Dodge Grand Caravan 2011 will be going places and people will be looking at it. The van is basically a moving billboard and in many ways, that’s a lot better than the ones that just stay still. Additionally, vehicle decals are very cost-effective considering their lifetime and maintenance.

About the decals, the client initially wanted to get Magnetic Vinyl Decals on his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we respect our client’s vision and preferences. However, we believe it is our duty to make the customer aware of all the possible options and risks with what they’re choosing to go for. After that, the client is the one who eventually calls the shots.

Since he wanted Magnetic Vinyl Decals, our installers advised him to go for more reliable standard Vinyl Decals. We explained all the demerits of getting Magnetic Decals as opposed to Regular Vinyl Decals such as the risk of magnets getting weak over time or peeling off of the vehicle when it is going above a certain speed. The client greatly appreciated our installers offering their expert advice and expressing a concern that was in his best interest. Upon receiving the advice, the customer did some thinking and decided to get Standard Vinyl Decals for his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011.

The client wanted decals on several areas including the hood, the sides, the back window, and the trunk of his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011. The hood, sides, and trunk had regular Vinyl Decals. However, he chose to go with perforated decals for the back window. Perforated decals are a special type of vehicle decals that have holes in them to make them partially see-through. The perforated decals that we used had a 60:40 ratio. 60% being the vinyl and 40% being the holes. These types of decals are legal, but we advise that you contact your insurance company to confirm whether they’re acceptable or not.

Our team took on this job with the same enthusiasm as we do for every other job we get. Our installers have more than a decade of experience wrapping vehicles and they treat the vehicle with the utmost care. The client, like when he worked with us the last time, left with complete satisfaction.

We’ve attached some pictures of the Dodge Grand Caravan, before and after getting decals on this page.

blocks.html:
VAN WRAPS AS OPPOSED TO ANY OTHER MARKETING TACTIC:

Being in the business and constantly looking for opportunities to attract more potential customers has become a norm in the 21st century. With countless businesses offering the same services and targeting similar customers, it has become a headache to create something that actually attracts customers to engage with your business. The pressure is enough to make anyone feel like they have writer’s block. So, what is it that you can do to make your business shine a little brighter than the others? The answer couldn’t be vaguer.

The market is a maze when it comes to choosing the right strategy for marketing. There is online advertising, flyers, posters, newsletters, and a lot more. The strategy you end up picking depends on what your needs are. However, the basic need for every marketing tactic is to be visible to as many customers as possible.

What happens in most of the above-mentioned cases is it doesn’t work. Why? You ask. Well, when was the last time you were happy to have an ad shoved in your face while you were watching your favourite show or while playing a relaxing mobile game? Exactly. That kind of marketing is very aggressive and has a very low success rate. What ends up happening is you losing your money?

What if we told you there’s a way to advertise your business in a non-aggressive way? Not a lot of people know about it. Considering you have a vehicle or if your business has a fleet then there’s a good chance you have a set of vans working for your business. Why not get those vans wrapped with vinyl wraps or decals to advertise your business? Use those vans to spread the word.

A Vinyl Wrap is a customizable material with an adhesive that sticks to the surface of your vehicle. Once wrapped, your van will look like it has just gone through a custom paint job. We’ve attached some images on this page for you to see how a van wrap can turn your van into a moving billboard, advertising your business wherever it goes. The good thing is when you’re advertising through a van wrap, you’re not being aggressive and forcing anyone to see your ad, people will look at it if they want to. Apart from being a non-aggressive and effective way of advertising, here are additional advantages of getting a van wrap:

  1. Saves you a fortune; considering the lifetime of a vinyl wrap, you can drive around with your wrapped vans for years before the vinyl starts to lose the battle against time.
  2. Protects your van; A full van wrap basically acts as a protective shield and protects your van from UV rays and road debris.
  3. Paint Protection; one of the sweetest additional perks of getting a full van wrap is its ability to freeze time for the colour of your van. When years later you decide to take off the wrap, you’ll be thrilled to see that it looks nearly new underneath.
  4. Freedom of Customization; Van wraps allow you full freedom of customization. From choosing the area you want to be wrapped to the design you want on the wrap, you get full freedom to imagine and see it manifest into reality.
  5. Get it done and forget about it; A vehicle wrap, once done, you can just forget about it. It requires the least amount of maintenance.

So, now that you know about all the delicious perks you get with a vehicle wrap. Here’s a list of what we offer here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto:

  • Full Vehicle Wrap; The entire vehicle is wrapped eg. to change colour or full design.
  • Partial Vehicle Wrap; More than 50% of the vehicle is wrapped with vinyl.
  • Decals; Variable-sized custom-designed vinyl stickers eg racing stripes, company logos, etc.
  • Paint protection films; A thin film that protects the paint of your vehicle.

Check more of what we offer, on our home page.

Here are some FAQs about Vinyl Wrap Toronto:

1. What kind of vehicles do we wrap?

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we can wrap almost all kinds of vehicles and objects including Cars, Vans, Trucks, Boats, RVs, Golf Carts, Motorcycles, walls and so much more. Our motto is if it has a smooth surface, we can wrap it.

2. What kind of material do we use?

We use only premium wrap material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M to wrap the vehicles.

3. What makes us so confident that we can take on a job?

Our team of professional graphic designers, experienced installers, and industry-standard printing equipment as a whole is what gives us the confidence to take on a job and do it with perfection.

4. How long does it take to wrap a vehicle?

That’s a tough one. Depending on the type of vehicle and the complexity of the design, the time taken to wrap a vehicle can vary. Our installers take their time to perform the job with perfection instead of doing a quick and lousy job.

Full Vinyl Wrap For Tesla Model 3 2020

Everyone is passionate about something in their lives. That’s what we’re here for, to chase our passions. It isn’t life if you’re not running after what you desire. We’ve got the perfect story for you. About a man who made his vision come to life in our garage at Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

Being in the Business, we receive all kinds of wrap requests; From personal vehicle wraps to commercial vehicle wraps. It gives us great pleasure that we’re able to make things happen and put a smile on our customers’ faces.

Since what we do is all about creativity and pushing the limits, we get to work for the most creative and innovative clientele. Because what they want is to make their vehicle one of a kind, and that requires creative genius.

Car companies, in most cases, only manufacture cars in very limited and general colours. This is their way to make sure they only release the colours that most people wouldn’t mind having. For example, it’s very unlikely that a car model will come in green, but there will always be black and white.

With only limited colours available, what happens is that everyone winds up with the same standard-looking car? It can be pretty disappointing to see that you’re not the only one with that car. However, not everyone wants a car in one of those standard colours.

So, what can you do if you want to give your car the colour you want? A Vinyl Wrap. Yes, welcome to the dreamland where you can make your car look the way you want. There are no limits. Anything you can imagine, Vinyl Wrap Toronto can wrap your vehicle with it.

Speaking of colour change, we recently received a full car wrap order from Mr. Andrews. What makes this job interesting is that it conveys the message that you take what you get and turn it into what you really want. It was a personal wrap request.

Mr. Andrews had recently bought a Tesla Model 3 2020. In fact, it was bought just 24 hours before we received an order to wrap it. Why? You ask. Because of the colour, Mr. Andrews didn’t want to wait for a black Tesla Model 3 to be delivered when he could get an early delivery for a white one. Tesla also charges more for the Black version and does not offer a Satin finish.

So, he decided to buy the white car and get it wrapped in a colour that he couldn’t get. The client was very specific about what he wanted. He wanted to have his white Tesla Model 3 wrapped with Satin Black Vinyl.

So, literally 24 hours after receiving his Tesla Model 3 2020, he dropped it off at our garage to get it wrapped. Now, there’s a man making things happen for himself. We were pleased to receive the opportunity to offer Mr. Andrews the car of his dreams.

As always, our installers took it into their hands and started the wrapping process. Our installers make sure they wrap the vehicles with the utmost care as if it’s our own. So, we took apart the car into several parts. This is because it becomes easier to wrap individual parts as opposed to wrapping one giant car. This ensures that the parts are wrapped with precision and accuracy. All in all, we had the car in our garage for three days.

Our installation team turned the White Tesla Model 3 into Satin Black. We admire the taste of the owner. The outcome was beautiful and Mr. Andrews’s reaction when he saw his Satin Black Tesla Model 3, was everything to us. We’d be lying if we said we didn’t expect that reaction. He left with an ear-to-ear smile on his face. He was overjoyed at his Tesla Model 3.

You may be wondering, why didn’t he go for a paint job? There are several reasons why he didn’t want to get a custom paint job:

  • Paint jobs are expensive: Getting a car painted isn’t as cost-effective as getting a vinyl wrap. The price of paint jobs varies depending on how popular or luxurious a car is.
  • Paint jobs have limited options for colour, design and finish: When it comes to freedom to imagine, a paint job is nowhere near the customizability and freedom offered by Vinyl Wraps. Vinyl Wraps allow you to choose any colour of your liking, get any logo or graphic printed on Vinyl and choose a finish such as matte, satin, gloss etc. In this case, the client wanted a full wrap for his Tesla Model 3; changing it from glossy white to satin black.
  • Paint Jobs replace the original colour of your vehicle: A paint job basically means taking off the original colour and painting it with the colour you picked. Now if you have a car that has been damaged and the paint is already ruined, it makes sense. But like in this case, the customer had just bought this Tesla Model 3 and it had the perfect new car paint job. He could have either gotten rid of the original colour and gotten the new colour or he could have kept them both. He made the right choice, Vinyl Wraps make sure the original paint of your vehicle remains intact. In fact, a wrap protects it from UV rays, debris and other environmental factors. So that when years later you decide to take off the Vinyl Wrap. You still have that perfect factory colour for your car.
  • Paint Jobs take longer: Looking at the fact that the client had just bought this car 24 hours before he dropped it off at our garage, you can tell that the client wanted to get things done quickly. And he knew getting a vinyl wrap is a lot faster than getting his Tesla Model 3 painted.

So, after considering the above-written reasons, the client made the decision to get a Vinyl Wrap instead of a paint job.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we appreciate and take great pleasure in wrapping vehicles for clients like Mr. Andrews.

If you wish to give your vehicle a brand new look, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts and get a quote on car wrap cost. Check out more car wraps here.

Ford Mustang 2 Tone Stripes by Vinyl Wrap Toronto

“A good friend knows all your best stories, but a best friend has lived them with you”. Friendship is a beautiful bond between people. Friends are human beings who make tough times hurt less and make good times the best moments of our lives. If you’ve got friends who bring the best out of you, you have a lot to be grateful for. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we recently got to witness two friends who shared a similar interest in things. Too similar if you think about it. But hey! We were happy to see them doing things together and making milestones in their journey of friendship.

When you see friends doing matching things together, it is to show their appreciation for one another and the similar interests they share. Doing events with friends not only gets you what you want but also gives you a memory to cling to when you’re feeling low. A few days ago, we had two friends walk into our garage, asking to get stripes on their cars. When we enquired and took a look at the cars, we knew these gentlemen were really good friends. And they were not at all trying to hide it.

Both gentlemen had Ford Mustangs. One had a Black Mustang 2020 California Special and the other one had a Blue Mustang 2020. There’s no way it was a coincidence that they didn’t discuss car options before getting the Mustangs.

These Gentlemen wanted to get racing stripes on their Mustangs. They wanted to make a statement and we believe they had the right idea. Who wouldn’t notice two mustangs with similar Stripes? However, when they arrived, it was just an idea. These gentlemen were undecided on a lot of their options, such as the colour of stripes they wanted, material, design and ultimate finished look. Our team took it into their hands and offered their expert advice to help the clients to make a decision.

When you’ve been working in the industry for as long as our installers have, you develop a skill to figure out what the client would like. So, our installers talked to them and answered all their questions about the colours, finishes and materials. We showed them colour swatches to see what the finish and colour actually look like on the Mustangs.

The gentlemen greatly appreciated our team’s effort in helping them to make a decision. After their discussion with our team, the gentleman with the Blue Mustang made a decision to get Avery Dennison’s SW900 Matte Dark Grey coloured stripes. It was something he wouldn’t have originally gotten but after talking to our installers, he felt it was the right way to go.

The friend with the Black Mustang was a bit more specific about what he wanted. In the past, he had actually tried to install stripes by himself, but obviously, it didn’t go as well as he had hoped. While we appreciate a person who is self-reliant, there are some things that you should get done by experts.

Not only does it save you money, but it also gets you quality that you just can not get out of a ‘DIY’ job. So, after a failed attempt, he decided to get it done professionally. The client wanted 2 Tone Stripes. The inner Stripes are Avery Dennison’s Matte Metalic Charcoal and the outer stripes are Avery Dennison’s Matte Metalic Silver. A great choice indeed.

After helping them reach a decision and making sure what the clients want, our designers started to render the designs on digital mockups. We have a team of skillful designers who specialize in vehicle graphics, capable of rendering any design onto a vehicle layout as long as the client has given clear instructions. It didn’t take us long to get the digital mockups ready and show them to the customers. The clients liked what they saw and approved the mockups.

The next and the most sensitive step was to actually install the stripes on the cars. The Stripes go from the hood all the way to the back through the roof. It isn’t as easy as it may seem at first, an example being one of the clients trying to install the stripes by himself and not getting the desired results. Our installers took the stripes and installed them on both cars with the utmost care and precision.

The results were as expected by our team, spectacular. The two Mustangs certainly did make a statement after getting a touch of stripes. We’ve attached some pictures on this page for you to see. The clients were fully satisfied with the results and couldn’t wait to take their pride and joys out for a drive.

Adding Stripes to a vehicle is a great way to make it look a lot more personalized. It’s hard to miss a car that has some really cool stripes running down the center of the vehicle. Especially when the colour of the stripes complements the car’s colour. You could get stripes in any shape or size and anywhere on the car. All you have to do is decide that you want stripes and we’ll make it happen.

Read: Things to remember when getting stripes on your vehicle.

If you’ve decided to get stripes on your car or are just considering it, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4. We would love to answer any questions you may have about your options.

To read more stories about vehicle wraps, please visit our blog page. Check out more car decals here.

blocks.html:
Vehicle Decals for Mercedes Sprinter Bluetec 2015

Decals are variable-sized vinyl stickers that adhere to the surface of a vehicle. The shape or size of decals is entirely customizable and can vary depending on the client’s taste or requirement. It could be a personal graphic or a company logo; the reason could be anything. In this story, our customer decided to get decals on his Mercedes Sprinter Cargo Van to promote a family business.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto recently received a request for promotional vehicle decals from a son who wanted to surprise his father. The Father and Son operate a company named “Regal Heights Marble” which is a Tile and Slab installation business. The Son wanted to take the business marketing to the next level and promote their business using the real estate on their company vehicle which is the Mercedes Sprinter Bluetec 2015.

The client specifically chose to get decals because he wanted something minimal yet interesting enough to make the vehicle stand out in the crowd. The beauty of getting vehicle decals is that you have full control over the size, colour, design and finish; basically, all aspects of the way you want the decals to look.

For the sides, the client approved to get a black background with their company information in the gold-coloured text to be placed on the back windows. This was to add privacy to the rear of the van. For that Vinyl Wrap Toronto used the premium quality material; Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series Printable Vinyl. The Decals on the sides beautifully display their company logo along with contact information such as phone number, website and email. With similar information for the back window decals, the client went with a different design, for which we used 60/40 perforated vinyl.

The client was fully satisfied with the end results and he drove home with his personalized moving billboard of a vehicle. We’ve featured some images on this page for you to take a look at.

The reason why this client chose to get decals for his Mercedes Sprinter Bluetec 2015 was to promote their business. Your reason could be different. So, to help you reach a decision,

Here are some of the benefits of getting decals over other modes of marketing:

  1. Vehicle Decals are extremely cost-effective, especially when you consider their lifetime and low maintenance.
  2. Vehicle Decals allow you full freedom to imagine. Anything you can imagine can be turned into decals.
  3. Decals offer a large variety of colours and finish options.
  4. Compared to full or partial wraps, decals are far easier to install.
  5. Vehicle Decals last for years and require little to no maintenance. So, you can literally just get decals and forget about them for several years.
  6. Decals give you the option to personalize your vehicle and freshen up its look.

Read Vehicle Decals; Make your vehicle stand out with your own personal touch.

To see more pictures of vehicles we’ve done, visit our blog page here.

If you wish to get decals or wraps for your vehicle, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4. We’d love to answer any of the questions you have and give a quote. Check out more van decals here.

blocks.html:
RV Full Wrap By Vinyl Wrap Toronto

When you’re looking to update something that’s as big as an RV, it is important that you’re aware of all of your options. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we do our best to spread awareness about vinyl wraps. So recently, we sent out promotional calendars to thousands of our neighbours.

This couple owned an RV and it had been with them for a long time. They decided it was time to give it a fresh look. The couple was originally looking to get the RV painted. Fortunately, it was around the same time we sent out promotional calendars. Upon receiving Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s calendar, the couple decided to visit our garage and talk to our team. We answered all of their questions and showed them examples of our previous and current wraps.

After the meeting, the couple had to make a choice and they made the right one when they decided to get a vinyl wrap because we explained all the advantages that vinyl wraps offer. All they wanted to do was to freshen up the RV’s look. However, they didn’t yet have a specific design that they wanted to get. So, our experts helped them make up their minds. After they agreed to get a custom design of their choice, it was time for our skilled graphic designers to start rendering the design into a digital mockup. Being experienced in their crafts, it didn’t take long for our designers to accomplish a look that the client loved.

The clients approved the designs and we started the printing process in-house. We used Avery Dennison printable with matching laminate. Our installers then took over and started the actual wrapping process. Wrapping is not as easy as it sounds, especially when the vehicle is as large as a 40ft RV. One small mistake and it’ll be the only thing people see, like a stain on white. Our installers take their job seriously and handle the vehicles with the utmost respect as if it’s their own. On top of a full wrap, we installed two “Discovery” stickers on the RV.

The end result was as expected, perfect and the clients will testify that. After seeing their wrapped RV the couple referred us to their friends and one of them wants to get their golf car wrapped by us. Since the clients are so happy with the results they want to get their Smart Car Fortwo and a friend’s Golf Cart wrapped by Vinyl Wrap Toronto, so keep a lookout if you’d like to see the pictures after we’re done wrapping them.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto is always open to challenges and although it wasn’t much of a challenge for our installers, it was a bit too big to fit into our garage. So, we arranged for a bigger place to wrap it. The couple was completely satisfied with the job we did. We’ve attached some pictures on this page for you to see.

Read: Personalize your vehicle with Vinyl Decals.

To see more pictures of the vehicles we’ve wrapped, check out our blog page here.

If you’re looking to give your vehicle a fresh new look, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4, to speak to one of our experts and get a quote.

blocks.html:
The BAOBAB Project – Helping Out Our Less Fortunate Friends

The world is a fast-moving place. Sometimes people can’t catch up with the pace and they fall through the cracks, which has an even more damaging effect on their children. If you’re reading this, you have a lot to be grateful for and the least we can do is try to put a smile on the faces of our less fortunate friends.

Recently, one of our team members came across Mr. Steve who has started a local charity called the “BAOBAB Project”. BAOBAB Is an abbreviation for “Being About Our Brother’s Awesome Business”. What the charity does is, it collects damaged abandoned bicycles, gets them repaired and gives them to our little friends who could use a bicycle. Or they repair the bikes for free for our friends who have damaged their bikes and want to get them back on the road.

When we met Mr. Steve and found out about this wonderful cause, we offered our helping hand to support the initiative. We installed Vinyl Decals on Mr. Steve’s Bicycle Trailer to spread awareness about the cause.

We did not wrap the whole trailer as the budget had to be taken into account as this was a charity organization. Mr. Steve also did not want anything too loud or in your face. We settled on the decals you can see in the photos.

Mr. Steve says the following about the project:

The BAOBAB project is the result of many people joining hands to “BAOBAB” or Being About Our Brother’s Awesome Business. Jesus was in the business of reconciling people to God and to each other, and we see one way to bring people together is over bicycles. This year, between the efforts of many churches, New Hope Community Bikes in Hamilton, friends rescuing bikes from scrap as far away as Scarborough and Cottage country, and bikes from neighbors, we’ve been able to refurbish and give out around 250 bikes to the neighborhood kids and other people who needed them. We have put bikes on hold for the winter months but look forward to resuming operations in the spring.

“Many thanks to Paolo and the crew at Vinyl Wrap Toronto for the beautiful signage and trailer decals that make our presence brighter and much more professional”.

We appreciate him giving us the opportunity to help.

If you have a bicycle that you no longer wish to keep or if you know someone who could use a free bike repair, the BAOBAB project is offering a helping hand. You may contact Mr. Steve at 416-371-9660 if you come across such a case. Your contribution could be the reason for someone’s dream coming true.

blocks.html:
Audi A4 2006 Sand Wrap By Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Inspiration can strike from anywhere. Our recent client, Mr. Anthony will relate to that. The Vinyl Wrap Toronto team recently did a full wrap for an Audi A4 2006 with Sand Texture Vinyl having Decals on top.

This story is particularly interesting because it goes on to show how sometimes the things we aim for can differ from the things we end up getting. Initially, the client wanted to go with a camouflage design. The final design was inspired by a beautiful BMW that the customer came across online. Many of our personal wrap customers take inspiration from images or influences they find online.

We started the process to create a digital mock-up for his Audi A4 to show him what his wrap would look like. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we make it our mission to offer our clients advice that is in their best interest. So, while in the process, our team had a talk with the client and made him aware of the potentially better options he could go with. One of those options was a Matte Sand Texture. The client seemed to like that better than what he originally intended So, he made the decision to move forward with the Matte Sand Texture with decals on top.

After the design was approved, we started the printing process. We used Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl from their SW900 series. Then laminated it with Avery Dennison’s Matte lamination. Our installers wrapped the Audi A4 with perfection and installed the Gloss Black Decals on top.

This was a personal wrap and the client wanted to give his car a unique touch of his own. For the Decals, he chose to go with quotes that were close to his heart. The quotes he chose are:

  • “Your journey is different from theirs, keep it moving”.
  • “Still downloading…” – Above the fuel cap with the intention to be funny.

A great choice indeed. The Audi A4 2006 after being wrapped, looked completely different and our customer will testify to that with his sheer joy and excitement. The client told us it feels like buying a new car. We’ve attached some pictures on this page for you to see.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s recent customer’s car was a bit of a father & son project. He brought to us his Mazda Miata 1990 and it was clear that it has gone through a lot of bodywork which rendered it looking completely different than the factory finish.

Due to the amount of work required, it left the car covered in paint primer. The Mazda Miata lost most of the original blue colour that it came in. The client was very specific about what he wanted. All he wanted to do was to revive his old-looking car which had grown old with time back to the original factory look.

Not only did he know what he wanted, but he also supplied his own material. Normally we do not accept or use customer-supplied material unless it is less than 6 months old and either Avery Dennison or 3M vehicle vinyl.

Our installers took the blue-coloured vinyl that he brought and started wrapping the Mazda Miata. The best wrapping material is worth nothing if it isn’t being installed by professionals. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have capable installers who take their job seriously. We treat our client’s vehicles with the utmost respect and care as if it’s our own.

This was a personal full wrap job. The client had a reason to get the job done. Yours could be different.

What are the benefits of Vinyl Wraps:

  1. It allows you to express yourself by giving your vehicle a unique touch of your own.
  2. Vinyl Wraps protect the vehicle’s original paint when doing a full or partial wrap.
  3. Vehicle wraps can last for years with minimal maintenance.
  4. Wraps protect the vehicle against UV rays, dust, and road debris.
  5. Vinyl Wraps are cost-effective compared to other vehicle customization alternatives.

Read VWT’s list of top 5 personal car wraps.

If you’ve got a vehicle that could use a bit of vinyl goodness, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage. We’re located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W1B4. Our experts will be more than happy to answer any of your queries and give you a quote.

To see more pictures of wrapped vehicles like the Mazda Miata 1990, check out our blogs page. Check out more car wraps here.
