Mercedes CLA250 Chrome Delete By Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Car manufacturers believe most of the public likes the look of shiny chrome trim. For most people, something like this isn’t an issue. However, what if you feel like the chrome trim is withholding your car’s true beauty?

Vinyl Wrap Toronto can take care of that for you. With a Chrome Delete procedure, we can cover the chrome trim in any colour you desire. You’d be surprised to see the difference it can make. For example, a black car with silver chrome trim isn’t truly black because the silver will always overshadow the black. The solution is to get a chrome delete job and have the chrome trim covered in black colour and a finish that matches the rest of your car or a colour that you think will enhance the beauty of your car.

Our recent customer proves, how you can use a chrome delete job to make your car look more stylish. The client dropped off his red Mercedes CLA250 at our garage. Red is an interesting colour and there aren’t many colours that go along with red. Our customer wanted to get rid of the silver chrome trim around the windows of his Mercedes CLA250.

The client wanted to turn the silver trim into black. Chrome delete jobs can be tricky for someone who does not have years of experience. It requires attention to detail and full control over hands to ensure accuracy and precision. So we suggest getting it done by professionals. We have installers working with us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto who has been working in the industry for more than a decade.

Our installers finished the chrome delete job for the Mercedes CLA250 in a matter of a few hours and the outcome as always was fully satisfying, the client will testify to that statement. Now the black complemented the red on the Mercedes CLA250. We’ve attached some before and after pictures of the vehicle for you to see the difference it makes.

In most cases, the reason to get a Chrome delete job is to enhance the look of a vehicle. Your reason could be anything.

If you wish to get rid of the chrome trim, we’re here to make it happen. Contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts and get a quote.

blocks.html:
Truck Decals & Truck Lettering – Vinyl Wrap Toronto

When it comes to spreading awareness about your brand, there are countless ways to achieve it. How you choose to promote your business depends on the industry you’re working for and your target customers.

If you’re working in an industry that involves using trucks or vans to carry out your business duties, we have the solution that will advertise your business for years to come with a one-time investment.

That magic solution is Truck Decals & Lettering.

Truck Decals:

Decals are variable-sized vinyl stickers cut out in a specified shape and size. A couple of decals have the ability to turn your vehicle into a moving billboard. Or if you just want to personalize your vehicle with your favourite design or logo, decals are the way to go. Truck Decals give you full freedom to do the following:

  1. The Shape & Size: No matter what shape or size your logo has, we can turn it into a decal and install it on your truck.
  2. Colour & Finish: You get to choose from a wide spectrum of eye-catching colours and finishes from 3M and Avery Dennison (Matte, Gloss, Satin).
  3. Installation and Removal Any Time: Truck Decals are easy to apply and be removed by professionals.
  4. Anywhere on your Vehicle: Truck Decals can be installed almost anywhere on the vehicle including but not limited to, the hood, roof, sides, back, windows, etc.

Truck Lettering:

As the name suggests, lettering is vinyl stickers cut out to make letters and put together to form words and sentences. Truck Lettering allows you to put your slogans or favourite quotes on your vehicle. Here are some of the things you have full control over if you wish to get truck lettering:

  1. The Font & Size: You can get your text in any font you desire and have it cut out in any size you want.
  2. Colour & Finish: Similar to decals, you get full freedom to choose the colour that you wish to get as well as the finish such as Matte, Gloss, and Satin.
  3. Easy to Install and Remove: Lettering is as quick to remove as install if you wish to take it off, no matter the reason if done by a professional.

To help you make a decision, here are some of the advantages of truck decals and truck lettering as opposed to other means of advertising:

  1. Decals & lettering are very cost-effective considering their lifetime.
  2. Once installed, decals & lettering can last for years before you have to think about replacing or removing them.
  3. Truck Decals are easy to install and remove.
  4. Decals have been proven to be an effective and non-aggressive way of advertising.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have professional installers who have been working in the industry for more than a decade. Over the years, we’ve made an unshakable reputation for ourselves. We work with clients from all over the GTA and particular cities like Mississauga, Etobicoke, Vaughan, Oakville, Scarborough, and Brampton.

For more info, read: Benefits of decals

If you’re considering getting decals, a full vehicle wrap, or a partial wrap, we’re here to make it happen for you. For any queries, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W1B4 to see us in action.

blocks.html:
Disney’s Cinderella Themed Full Wrap – Volkswagen Beetle 2015

One of the reasons why people prefer to get a vinyl wrap for their vehicles is the endless possibilities. There are no restrictions on the kind of design you can get on your vehicle. Our recent client proves it.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we appreciate the creative and interesting ideas that our clients come up with to wrap their vehicles. It is a way for them to personalize their vehicle to look exactly the way they want.

We recently had the pleasure to work with Ms. Andrea and bring her Disney fantasy to life. She contacted us about getting a full vinyl wrap for her Volkswagen Beetle 2015. At first, it must seem like a regular wrap request. However, when our team discussed the details with her, we found out she wanted to do something very special.

She wanted to wrap her entire Volkswagen Beetle in a theme that was inspired by the Disney Princess Cinderella. Now that’s a great way to show off what you’re passionate about. This idea of hers was inspired by something she saw online. She came across this image of a Volkswagen Beetle that had a similar theme to it and she immediately got her heart set on getting it for herself. She wanted the same theme but she gave it her own touch by rearranging and adding some extra elements. She reached out to the person whose car she saw online to ask their permission if it would be alright if she gets her car done in a similar theme.

It was an interesting project for our designers and installers working with us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. We did the job with great pleasure and brought her vision to reality. It was a full wrap for which we used Avery Dennison’s SW900 Diamond White & Gloss Smokey Blue. Installers at Vinyl Wrap Toronto only use premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M, because when it comes to our client’s pride and joys, there are to be no compromises with quality.

The procedure our installers followed was to wrap the entire car in Avery’s Gloss Smokey Blue vinyl and then on top of that Smokey Blue, we added the Diamond White decal to achieve the look as shown in the mockup prepared by our skilled team of designers. For the little details, we installed decals/lettering saying “Cinderella” on the sides and a mini-castle on the back & front.

Even though our part to wrap the car is done, she still has some modifications she wants to make to her car. A vinyl Wrap was a part of her journey to make her Volkswagen Beetle truly unique. We appreciate her allowing us to bring her one step closer to her fantasy car.

We have attached some pictures of the wrapped Volkswagen Beetle on this page for you to see how an ordinary car can turn into your dream car. She wanted a Disney theme and yours could be anything you want. All you have to do is give us a call and talk to one of our experts to get the ball rolling.

Update: Ms. Andrea has reupholstered the interior to match the Smokey Gloss Blue and Gloss White vinyl.

If you’ve got a vehicle that could use a bit of vinyl goodness, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage. We’re located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W1B4. We’d love to have you over for a tour and answer any questions you may have.

blocks.html:
Naruto Themed Motorcycle Decals – Kawasaki Ninja 400

When it comes to what you can do with a couple of custom-designed vehicle decals, the possibilities are truly limitless. Vinyl Wrap Toronto is an established Vehicle Wrapping Agency in Toronto. Over the years, we’ve wrapped vehicles and installed decals for countless of our customers. With all that work, we’ve seen a lot of designs and new ideas. In most cases, our clients impress us with their creative vision and out-of-the-box thinking.

Recently we had the pleasure of installing decals on a Kawasaki Ninja 400. The reason and inspiration behind this particular job are practical and goes on to show that you can turn your motorcycle into your fantasy bike. The client had laid down his motorcycle a couple of times and it resulted in the bike getting a couple of scratches. So, here’s the interesting part. The customer could have easily gotten rid of those scratches by any other means, but he chose to handle it in a way that would give him his fantasy motorcycle. He wanted several cloud-shaped decals all over his motorcycle along with some symbols on the head and tail.

The decals were inspired by a Japanese Anime Series, Naruto and clearly, the client was a big fan. He contacted our team and explained what he wanted. Our designers didn’t take long to create a mockup of the design showing what it would look like on the Kawasaki Ninja 400 and the client approved it. With his approval, we began the print and lamination process.

Although installing decals is generally easier than doing a full or partial wrap, but it can get tricky when you have a lot of decals that need to be aligned perfectly with each other. That’s where our installers’ experience comes in handy. The decals were installed with absolute precision and the client’s reaction when he saw the final product, proved it. We’ve attached some pictures of the Kawasaki Ninja 400 on this page for you to see how motorcycle decals can change the look of your bike.

To help you make a decision, here are some of the reasons why you should consider decals for your vehicle.

  1. Motorcycle decals are a cost-effective way to freshen up the look of your bike.
  2. Vehicle Decals are easy to install and remove (by professionals).
  3. You get to pick any colour, size, shape, and finish you want the vehicle decals to be.
  4. Decals are a great and non-aggressive way to advertise your business.
  5. Vehicle decals will last for years before you’ll have to think about replacing them.
  6. Along with having a long lifespan, decals require minimum maintenance.

So, if you’ve got a motorcycle or vehicle in need of a makeover, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to offer its services. For any queries or to get a quote, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

The inspiration behind getting the smart car done was that they wanted to reflect the same design that they got for their RV on their Smart Car ForTwo. Originally, what they wanted was to get a full wrap for the car, but later on, they decided that they wanted to go with minimal decals instead. The idea was to get wavy blue decals on the sides and a “Discovery” sticker on the back. We had an issue with the original wave design so had to adjust. When this happens our team comes together to ensure the customer is happy.

Considering decals are easier to install as compared to full or partial wraps, it didn’t take our team long to get the job done. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have experienced installers working with us to make sure every vehicle gets wrapped with absolute perfection and precision. Just like all the other jobs we’ve done, this one turned out to be exactly what the clients wanted. The reactions we receive from our clients are more than enough for us to know that we’ve done the job right.

We’ve attached some images of the Smart Car ForTwo for you to see how a couple of vehicle decals can make your car pop.

Vinyl Decals are a great idea if you’re looking to upgrade the look of your vehicle without breaking the bank. Here are some of the perks of getting decals as compared to any other means of vehicle modification:

blocks.html:
Honda Civic 2010 – Gloss Black Rose – Full Vinyl Wrap

When it comes to the battle between time and material things such as cars, it goes without saying, that time always wins. The car you bought a few years ago has lost that fresh new car look. The effects of time can be seen from the fading of the colour to minor scratches, etc.

When you’re in a situation where your vehicle is clearly starting to show its age, there are a couple of things you can do such as, sell it and get a new one, have it painted trying to revive its original look or like what our customer did in this case, get it fully wrapped in an eye-catching colour. All options involve time and money. The choice depends on a few details, like does it still run, any major dents or scratches and rust.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto recently added a Honda Civic 2010 to its portfolio of full car wraps. This client was looking to resurrect his Honda Civic which had been around the block for a long time and was clearly showing its life experience. The client contacted our team explaining what he was looking to accomplish.

Originally, he wanted to go for a black-coloured wrap for his Honda Civic 2010, but after talking to our team of installers and going through some swatches, he had a change of heart and decided to go for the Gloss Black Rose. The difference between standard gloss black and gloss black rose is clear from the photos included. The customer did not want to just be another Honda Civic on the road, he wanted to make a statement.

Our team took in the car and our installers worked their magic using the premium quality material offered by 3M’s 1080 Series. “Gloss Black Rose” is not that common of a colour that people go for when they get their cars wrapped, but since this client wanted that colour for his Honda Civic 2010, we sourced it from Calgary and got the job done. The final product came out looking flawless. It’s like a brand-new car, at least from the outside. We’ve attached some pictures of the wrapped Honda Civic 2010 on this page for you to see how a full wrap can change your car’s look entirely.

The client could’ve gone with other ways to get the colour changed, but he chose to go with a full vinyl wrap.

Benefits of Vehicle Wraps over Paint Jobs

  1. Vinyl Wrap Materials come in a huge variety of colours and finishes, thus giving you more options to consider.
  2. Vinyl Wraps last for years and require minimum maintenance.
  3. A full wrap protects your car against the sun and other environmental factors that decay the car over time.
  4. Unlike paint jobs, you don’t have to get rid of the original colour to get a vinyl wrap; You’ll still have the original colour intact when you decide to take off the vinyl wrap.
  5. Wraps are cost-effective considering their lifetime and durability.

These are just a few; there are a lot more reasons why vinyl wraps are considered the first choice when thinking of changing the colour and look of a vehicle.

If you have a vehicle that could use a fresh new look, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts about any questions or concerns you may have.

blocks.html:
Mini Cooper Hardtop Decals – A Dream Turned Into Reality

Vehicle Decals are your thing if you want to go wild with your imagination. If we haven’t made it clear by now, well, this story will for sure get you to believe in the power of decals. Being in the business for so many years, we have seen our fair share of interesting requests from our customers. Being able to manifest our clients’ vision, is what keeps us going. We are grateful to get the opportunity to work with these creative people.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto was recently contacted by Ms. Lodato through one of our social media platforms. To her, it seemed a little complex, she thought it would not be possible, but she took a chance. She was very clear about her dream. She wanted her tattoo turned into a vehicle decal and put on her Mini Cooper Hardtop’s Hood.

It was a custom-designed tattoo of a mythological dragonfly. At first glance, the tattoo looks like a mashup between a dragon and a dragonfly. Since she wanted something minimal and elegant, this tattoo decal was a really great idea.

The first challenge here for us was that she only had a picture of the tattoo’s original drawing. In order to turn it into a car decal, we had to convert the design shown in the picture into a vector file. Fortunately for her, Vinyl Wrap Toronto has a team of experienced graphic designers who have been manifesting our clients’ visions into reality for years. We took the job with great pleasure and started recreating the tattoo.

Now, one of the cool things about having something converted into a vector artwork file, is that you can actually have the design modified, which is exactly what she did. She wanted the dragonfly’s tongue to be a bit longer than it is on her tattoo. This was a simple request for our graphic design team.

We presented the converted file to her and she was quite impressed with the work we had done so far. She approved the design and we started the process to bring her dream to life.

We printed the design onto premium quality clear printable vinyl offered by 3M and laminated it. The vinyl was only as big as the design to help reduce the cost and meet the client’s budget. We only use quality material offered by 3M & Avery Dennison at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. Because when it comes to our client’s satisfaction, there are to be no compromises with quality.

Once everything was ready, it was a quick install for our installation team. It would be time-consuming and tricky for someone with little to no experience. Not for our installers, who have mastered the art of vehicle graphics and wraps over the years.

So, that’s the story of a creative client, who wanted something personal as a decal on her Mini Cooper Hardtop. We’ve attached pictures of the Mini Cooper Hardtop for you to see how well it turned out. What we got out of this as a lesson:

“One design multiple applications”.

To see more pictures of similar vehicles like the Mini Cooper Hardtop we’ve done, please visit our blog page here.

Ford Transit Passenger 250 – Promotional Decals

Now that the flu season is here, you’ll see a lot of buzz about flu shots. To promote and encourage people to get their flu shot, you’ll see authorities pushing the advertisement via a number of mediums, such as the internet, streaming services, TV, radio, etc.

The methods we mentioned above can be a bit aggressive since they interrupt a viewer’s activity and it can be a bit annoying. However, there is a way you can advertise where you won’t be shoving your ad in their faces, instead, they’ll be at full liberty to see or not see it.

Vehicle Decals are the answer when you want to utilize all the real estate on your vehicle and make sure your advertisement gets seen by people who are actually interested in looking at it. Thus having a greater chance of turning those viewers into potential customers. The Decals on the vehicle also provide as a marker for people looking for a mobile clinic.

Our recent client was aware of the power of vehicle decals. We had the pleasure to work with one of Toronto’s best Marketing & Advertising agencies, Klick Health. They brought 2 Ford Transit Passenger 250s to Vinyl Wrap Toronto. These Ford Transit Passenger 250s were to be their Mobile Flu Shot Clinics.

The company wanted to kill two birds with one stone. Which are:

  1. Promote and encourage people to get flu shots.
  2. Encourage people to join their team of klicksters.

We heard them and gave them exactly what they wanted. We installed decals on almost all sides of the vehicles. We used Avery Dennison’s Gloss Intense Blue from their SW900 Series and Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl. Vinyl Wrap Toronto always uses the best quality material. The decals are easy to read and aren’t all up in your face. We’ve attached pictures on this page for you to see how we turned two ordinary Ford Transit Passenger 250s into moving billboards.

Vehicle Decals are a preferred choice for business promotion because of the following reasons:

  • Vehicle Decals are relatively cost-effective, considering their lifespan and low maintenance.
  • You are the boss; you get full freedom to pick any size, shape, finish, and colour of decals.
  • Vehicle decals are a proven way to effectively promote a business of service.
  • Decals are easy to install and remove (By professionals).
  • You take your advertising with you wherever you go.

If you’ve got a vehicle that could be promoting your business every day as you drive, we’re here to make that happen for you. For any queries or concerns, feel free to contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4, to speak to one of our experts.

blocks.html:
Full Truck Wrap & Decals

Getting a wrap sounds a bit too much at first, but once you see what it can do for your business, you’ll use every opportunity to get your vehicle(s) wrapped. Similar is the case with our client “BamBam Construction”. The company bought a water truck to carry out their business duties on sites. Having a large truck and not using all the free real estate would have been such a waste of a perfectly good way to promote their business. “BamBam Construction” one of is our neighbours and returning clients.

We have done a similar job of wrapping their previous water truck and installing decals on other vehicles in the past. Since the client was fully satisfied with our work, he decided to contact us to get the second one wrapped, as well. Just like last time, it was the same truck, the Freightliner M2. However this time, the client took apart the truck himself to make the wrapping process easier for the installers working at Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

Wrapping a full truck requires the same effort as wrapping a small car. Our team uses only the premium quality material provided by Avery Dennison & 3M. For this particular job, we used Matte Black for the full truck wrap, Orange & White for the truck decals from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series. Since the water tank had been taken off, we were able to cover the back as well.

After covering the truck with Matte Black, our team installed decals on both sides and the hood of the truck. Here’s an interesting thing, the client had given the truck a name like the previous one. This one was called Caitlin, and there’s a decal of the name on both sides of the truck’s nose.

We’ve attached some pictures on this page for you to see how an ordinary truck can be your canvas where you advertise your business.

Tips For When You’re Getting A Vehicle Wrap/Decals

Now let’s talk about what you can do to get the best out of your promotional vehicle wrap:

  • Be clear on what you want: The brand or service you want to advertise
  • Keep the design minimal: make sure the information you’re trying to convey doesn’t get lost in other design elements.
  • Know your audience: Pick the colour and design based on the nature of your target audience. A bad example would be using skulls in the design that’s supposed to promote a salon.
  • Include Contact Information: Let’s say you grabbed your potential customer’s attention. The next thing they need is a way to contact you and if they don’t see it in that same second, it’s very unlikely that they will go out of their way to make a search on their own.
  • Explore your creativity: It’s all about standing out. Give people something interesting to look at. For example, a funny meme promoting your business.
  • Know your options: Before you make a decision, make sure you are aware of your options, such as the colour, type & finish of the material. Also about the level of wraps such as full, partial, or just plain decals.

At VWT we offer vehicle wrapping services including car wraps, van wraps, truck wraps, boat wraps and so much more. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our installers.

To read more about vinyl wraps and see more pictures, visit our blog page. To check out more truck wraps, click here.

blocks.html:
Volvo XC90 Hot Pink Decals as a Birthday Present by Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Birthdays are fun. However, it can be a mind field to pick a perfect gift for your spouse or someone that you love unconditionally. Only someone who thinks out of the box can think of getting decals on his wife’s Volvo XC90 for her birthday.

Mr. Pegoraro was looking to give his wife the perfect birthday gift. So while he was surfing the web for inspiration. Our client came across a job of installed decals that Vinyl Wrap Toronto had done in the past. The client found a picture of a Black Mercedes C63S that we installed red racing stripes on. That was enough for the inspiration to strike for him.

The client decided the best gift he could give her wife would be to get the racing stripes decals inspired by that Mercedes he saw on our website on his wife’s new Volvo XC90. The difference was that he chose a different style and colour.

It was a rush job for Vinyl Wrap Toronto, but we made time so this man could celebrate his wife’s birthday on time. However, the job came with its bumps. The colour he chose to get was pink, but the colour he chose was rare, and since he wanted it done quickly, we couldn’t get our hands on it in time. Fortunately for him, pink comes in various shades and finishes. We showed him some shades and he settled for one that was very close to the one he originally wanted. The colour we settled on was the “ G103 – Gloss Hot Pink” from 3M’s 2080 Series.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we always use quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M, because when it comes to our clients’ pride and joys, there are to be no compromises with quality.

Moving on, our designers quickly rendered a mockup showing how the stripes will look like, and sent it to the client. The client approved the design and we started the preparation process.

We made sure he got the job done the same day he dropped off the vehicle. In fact, the client sat in our garage while our installers worked their magic. On top of what was described, our installers added a bit of a touch of their own. The order was to install decals on the sides, front scoop, and mirrors. But our installers wanted to include another subtle decal around the license plate on the back of the Volvo XC90. Being in the industry for years, the client appreciated our installers’ input and effort.

The stripes came out looking “Hot”. The client took the Volvo XC90 home with a big smile on his face. This job gave us something more than just the satisfaction of a job well done. It gave us the chance to make a couple happy.

If you’ve got an idea to surprise a loved one with some custom-designed decals, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to make it happen. We do all kinds of vehicle wraps.

For any queries or concerns, please feel free to reach out to our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to see us in action.

For more stories and pictures, please visit our blog page. Check out more SUV wraps here.

blocks.html:
Mercedes Sprinter 2500 Vehicle Decals

We say “Get your business on wheels with promotional vehicle decals” but this client literally has his business on wheels, all the more reason to get decals. This is about the time we heard from this client who has a mobile hair grooming business.

The person who owns the business is actually from the US but he sent his Mercedes Sprinter 2500 to Toronto to get the inside fitted out with all the essential equipment needed to cut hair. We spoke with this client’s outfitter/middleman in the initial few months of 2020. At the time, he was looking to get some other work done for the Mercedes Sprinter 2500.

A few months later, he decided to get promotional vehicle decals on the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 to advertise the mobile business. Since he remembered having a chat with us, he thought to reach out to us again about a quote to get some vehicle decals.

After receiving a satisfactory quote from us, he brought in these pictures of the vehicle with dimensions as to where the vehicle decals are supposed to be. The problem here was that the pictures were of a different vehicle than the one he brought into our garage. This is a common misunderstanding for our clients. In order to perform our job with perfection, our installers need the accurate dimensions and positioning of decals. Since the dimensions he brought in were of a different vehicle, our installers and designers worked to get them right for the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 that the client brought in.

The installation process was fairly simple as it is in the case of most decal jobs. The decals show the logo for the mobile business on several locations and in a variety of sizes on the vehicle along with his Instagram username. We used “Gloss Metalic Gold” from Avery Dennison’s SW900 series for these decals. The black colour of the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 really makes the golden decals pop. The client left the garage happily just like the rest of our happy customers.

Expert Advice by Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s Installers

Having been working in the industry for more than a decade, experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have a few tips on where to get the decals on your vehicle. Similar to what we supplied to this client:

1. The Sides:

Sides are the biggest canvas on any vehicle if you’re looking to let your imagination out. Vehicle Decals installed on sides are easily visible and real estate gives you the ability to be creative. Get a couple of decals on either side and you’re good to go. Side decals are clearly visible to people driving parallel to you on the road.

2. The Hood:

Decals on the hood are effective for when you’re vehicle is parked somewhere. People walking past your vehicle can’t help but notice this giant sticker right on the hood of your car.

3. The Back:

The Lettering & Decals on the back are visible to people driving behind your vehicle. So get creative and put your business logo on the back for people to look at.

4. The Roof:

Not a lot of people go for Vehicle decals on the roof since they believe they aren’t visible to people. However, experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto would agree to disagree with that. With buildings with several floors and people looking out their windows, you can either show them a well-crafted ad or a plain old roof. The choice is yours.

Do you have a business that could use effective marketing? Contact our team today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 for information about vehicle graphics.

blocks.html:
Volkswagen Beetle 2015 – Cinderella-themed Interior Pieces

Like we’ve discussed before, it isn’t a one-time job to make the car your dream car. You will realize that once you get one thing done you’ll want another one. The same as tattoos, once the creativity is allowed out, it’s hard to stifle it. It’s human nature, and why shouldn’t we if it gives us the pleasure of having something really cool?

Our recent client Ms. Andrea had her Volkswagen Beetle fully wrapped by Vinyl Wrap Toronto. It wasn’t just an ordinary full wrap, it brought a Disney fantasy to life. The Volkswagen Beetle went through a full wrap to become one step closer to being the perfect car the second and final step required more of Disney’s magic.

She brought the car in for the second time to get the interior done. It was like last time, an interesting job for us and we did the job with great pleasure. It was a series of decals that went around the car from the inside. Decals featuring the vines, pumpkins, and the three mice from the classic Disney Cinderella story. She chose the colour “Gloss Smokey Blue” from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series.

Since it was a lot of detailing, weeding the vinyl was a bit tricky, however, it was all worth it when we saw what we had accomplished. Everyone from our team to the client loved how it turned out. We’ve attached the pictures of the Volkswagen Beetle’s interior and spoiler for you to feast your eyes on.

The thing about getting the interior of a car is that it does more for the owner of the car than it does for other people. Because the interior is something only the owner and the people who occasionally sit in the car, see. This goes on to say, it is absolutely worth it to do things that make you happy.

Tips While Getting the Interior of Your Car Done

To give you something to walk away with, experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have shared some gems carved with experience for when you wish to or consider getting the interior of your car done.

  • Follow Your Heart: This can not be stressed enough. You as the owner will be looking at the interior almost all of the time. So, it will be wrong to take advice from someone else. Who knows you better than you do? Ask yourself what you wish to see every day and you’ll have your answer. One trick would be to print out the design and stick it in place for a month and see if the design still gives you a
  • Take your time to make a decision: Following your heart and making an impulsive decision can turn into a nightmare pretty soon. It’s like that new song we can not stop listening to but after repeating it about a thousand times, you start hating it. Similarly, make sure you get something that you can stand for a long time before you get sick of it. The key is to try to be minimal.
  • Experiment with Colours and Finishes: Talk to an expert, it doesn’t cost anything if you’re just looking. See the available colour options you have and what kind of finish you want for the vinyl, it could be any Gloss, Matte, Satin, etc.
  • Picture it: Think of the inside of your car as your empty canvas and yourself as the artist. Anything you can imagine that fits on the pieces inside of your car that can be wrapped can be turned into reality.

If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our installers. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have a team of experts who have mastered wrapping vehicles such as cars, motorcycles, trucks, vans, boats, trailers, etc.

blocks.html:
Trailer Wrap

The world of vinyl wraps is an endless tunnel of ideas brought to reality by people who dare to think outside the box. The one thing you won’t find anywhere else is the level of freedom to make your vehicle look however you wish for it to look. And not just vehicles, it could be any object or surface.

Our returning client, Mr. Ken Bennington is a real estate agent. He recently bought a trailer that he lends to his clients to help them move stuff from their old place to their new homes. A great idea indeed and you know everyone who buys a property will need something to carry their stuff in. Along with that, Ken saw an opportunity, an opportunity to show who got these people the property.

He could have just kept using the ordinary trailer with nothing on it, but he saw the opportunity and took it since getting his Jeep wrapped brought him more business. He decided to use all the real estate on that trailer to show off his business in all of its glory using a custom vinyl wrap that goes all around the trailer. He contacted our team of experts and put forth his vision. Our team took it all in and designed the mockup as he had envisioned.

The design shows his business name, and contact information in big bold letters along with a cartoon representation of Ken Bennington himself holding a set of keys to a house in his background, leaving nothing to the imagination about what he does. Being interesting enough to catch the attention of people on the road is what modern advertising is all about and that’s exactly what we gave him.

To fully wrap his trailer, our team always uses the best quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M. For this particular job, since it was a custom design, we used Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl and Laminate. We’ve attached pictures of the trailer on this page for you to see what a promotional wrap should look like.

Tips for when you’re getting a promotional wrap:

  1. The first and most important thing is that you pick a design that’s most likely to attract the attention of others.
  2. Show off your logo, contact information, and services with bold and easy-to-read text.
  3. Include a fun element; as in this case, the client had himself represented as a cartoon. Now that’s something everyone will be looking at when the trailer is out on the roads.
  4. Talk to an expert about your options, such as the colour, finish and discuss your design.
  5. Keep it simple; Vehicles move quickly so you should go with something that can be read in a matter of seconds.

If you have any questions or concerns or would like to get a quote, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has years of experience wrapping all kinds of vehicles such as cars, motorcycles, trucks, RVs, boats and the list goes on.

To read more articles about vinyl wraps, visit our blog page.

To check out more trailer wraps, click here.

blocks.html:
Ford Mustang California Special 2019 Gloss White Racing Stripes

There are two kinds of people on earth. The people who have a car just for the sake of going from one place to another with the least regard to what the car looks like. And the second kind, the complete opposite of the first kind. For these people, driving is about making a statement wherever they go. This blog is for individuals belonging to the second; car enthusiast kind, if you think you’re the first type, everything after this sentence is only going to make you cringe (LOL).

The reason we’re including a segment about “Things to remember while getting racing stripes” is because this particular client, unfortunately, had to get them done all over again. Not because he didn’t like the job we did, but because he later realized the colour he picked for the stripes is not working for him.

He brought in his gorgeous Ford Mustang 2019 California Special a while ago and placed an order to get racing stripes at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. We took the car in and decided on what he wanted. At the moment the client had his heart set on getting the “Matte Dark Grey” from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series.

Although we did a flawless job, and the fact that he came back to us to get them done in a different colour proves it. The reason he wanted to replace those racing stripes on his Ford Mustang 2019 is that he believed the colour of those racing stripes didn’t enhance the beauty of it. He was unhappy with the contrast of how they looked on the Ford Mustang 2019. When the customer originally picked the colour, we gave him multiple options but ultimately it was his choice.

He came back to us with his Ford Mustang with almost new racing stripes and requested a change. This time he picked the “Gloss White” colour from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series. A colour that definitely made his blue beauty pop and is more to his style. Our installers did a marvellous job as always and the client drove home satisfied with the job. We’ve attached pictures of the Ford Mustang 2019 with the old stripes and new ones for you to see how much of a difference can colour selection make.

Inspired by this client’s situation, experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have some advice for anyone who’s looking to get racing stripes on their vehicle.

  • Deciding the kind of output you want is extremely important and you make up your mind about the kind of results you’re looking for, whether it should be minimal and subtle or it should be bright and not at all subtle, you need to know before placing an order.
  • Know your vehicle take a good look at your vehicle. The design, the colour and the finish, because the racing stripes you pick have to add to the beauty of all those things.
  • Know Your Options for Colours and FinishesIn order to make a better decision, it is important that you ask the installers for colour swatches so you can see the available colour and finishes. Giving you the opportunity to pick the one that catches your fancy.
  • Decide Where to get the stripes you decide to get the racing stripes can make a world of difference. Whether it is on the hood and top or on the sides, you should give it a thought before making a decision.
  • Explore around for inspiration whether you search online, go to car shows, or see a vehicle on the road you like. It’s best to take a picture or print out the design and keep it somewhere where you see it every day. That way you will be confident about the finished look when you get the wrap.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding racing stripes or any other vehicle graphics, reach out to our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

blocks.html:
Nissan Rogue 2014 Full Wrap

A car just like everything else in life, ages with time. When it reaches the point where you start to feel like the car is showing its age, generally there are two options. Option A, you can get a new car and spend a lot of money and Option B, where you can freshen up the look of your car for a lot less. Option B was the clear winner for this client as she felt it’s just the exterior that was looking old.

Our recent client Ms. Lizzy has a Nissan Rogue 2014 which has been around fighting the good fight against time for more than six years. The Nissan Rogue started to look tired and she felt it was time to breathe some life into it. She contacted our team to discuss her options and to make an appointment.

Since she was aware of her options and the capability of vinyl wraps, she wanted to make her Nissan Rogue one of a kind. With the help of our installers, she picked a good combination of different colours and finishes for her Nissan Rogue that complemented each other. For the hood, roof, and tailgate she picked the Matte Metalic Blue, Brushed Black for sides and bumpers and for the hood stripe, she picked the Brushed Bronze all from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series.

Each colour and finish gave the Nissan Rogue a unique charm and at the end of the wrapping process, turned it into a unique work of art. Our installers, as always did the job with the utmost attention to detail. We’ve attached pictures of the wrapped Nissan Rogue on this page for you to see by yourself.

Why Vinyl Wraps Are Better:

This full wrap allowed our client to completely change the look of her Nissan Rogue with something that she wanted and that’s just one of the perks of getting a vinyl wrap.

Let’s see what vinyl wraps can offer you:

  1. You can pick any colour from the spectrum in a range of cool finishes such as matte, gloss, satin, brushed, etc.
  2. Vinyl Wraps let you be Leonardo Da Vinci and your car becomes your canvas; you can literally get any design, and mix and match things.
  3. Vinyl Wraps last for 6-7 years with minimal maintenance.
  4. Vehicle wraps protect the original paint of your vehicle from the sun and other environmental factors. Not only does it give your car a cool look that you get to pick, but also protects the original paint.
  5. Continuing the above point, you get to keep the original colour as well, which is not the case if you decide to go for a custom paint job. So, if the paint on your car is fine and you wish to be able to revert back to the same colour years later when you decide to unwrap your vehicle, vinyl wrap is the ideal choice.

If you have any more questions or concerns regarding vinyl wraps, decals or stripes, feel free to speak to our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4. We wrap all kinds of vehicles including cars, trucks, vans, trailers, RVs, boats, etc for both personal and commercial purposes.

To read more stories, visit our blog page. Check out more of our work here.

blocks.html:
Nissan NV2500 Full Van Wrap + Decals

If you’re looking to promote your business by turning your vehicle into a moving billboard that advertises your brand, you are on the right website. Vinyl Wrap Toronto is one of the well-known car wrap or vehicle wrap shops in Toronto.

We recently had the pleasure of working with a repeat client “Metro Jet Wash” – A property maintenance company located in Etobicoke. The client had just bought a brand new Nissan NV2500 Van in White. However, they had a different colour for it in mind. So they contacted us to see if we could bring their vision to life.

The client wanted to wrap the whole Nissan NV2500 Van in with Satin Black vinyl, featuring an image of one of their honourable employees and on top of that, the client wanted promotional decals all around the van.

Since the client wanted a satin finish on all the material, we went ahead and ordered what was needed. We used Satin Black, Santin Laminate & Printable Vinyl from Avery Dennison’s SW900 series. Our installers first did a full wrap on the Nissan NV2500 then installed the promotional decals on top. For the decals, the client wanted to match the colour of their logo and we did our homework to find out the exact colour code for their logo and printed the decals. Our team has years of experience in meeting customers’ needs and desires.

Our installers did the job with the utmost respect and care for the vehicle. And as a result, the client was fully satisfied with the job we did on their Nissan NV2500. We’ve attached pictures of the wrapped van on this page for you to see.

Their decision to get promotional decals all around the fully wrapped Nissan NV2500 is a smart idea for two reasons:

  1. It made sure the van is advertising the business from all directions.
  2. Since the decals are on top of the full wrap so they won’t have any tan line when and if they’re removed.

This was a promotional full wrap and our clients generally wonder why do commercial wraps cost less than personal wraps. The answer to that question is that it happens because of the following reasons:

  • Commercial Full Wraps are simple and easy to design: Being Promotional the text and logos are kept extremely easy to read and in the basic fonts, so it doesn’t take that much design effort as it does to design for a personal wrap job.
  • Commercial Decals are Easy To Install: Since the decals are just text in a basic font, it is easier to install those as opposed to complex personal decals.
  • Commercial Decals Do not Require The Little Details to Be Wrapped: In the case of promotional full wraps, it is not required to wrap the unnecessary parts of the vehicle. Such as door handles. Thus saving on material and installation effort.

If you have a vehicle that you wish to wrap or get decals on for either promotional purposes or personal, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts about your requirements. We do full wraps, partial wraps as well as decals and lettering. We have experience wrapping motorcycles, cars, vans, trucks, trailers, RVs, boats, and a lot more.

To read more articles, please visit our blog page here. Check out more van wraps here.

blocks.html:
Nissan Juke 2016 – Gloss Atomic Teal Decals

Car enthusiasts know how important and fun it is to take an ordinary car and turn it into their fantasy car. Our recent client Ms. Shari is one of those people who are passionate about their pride and joys. From the time we first interacted with her, we came to know she absolutely loves her Nissan Juke 2016.

She has joined and followed a lot of groups and pages dedicated to her baby (Nissan Juke). She was an active part of these groups, always looking for inspiration or ideas from the modifications other people had done to their Nissan Jukes. After looking for something that matches her style she finally came across something that she wanted for her own Nissan Juke. The Juke is was discontinued in 2017, this adds to the dedication and love for her Nissan like Ms. Shari.

She was still sorting through the options she could take when she contacted us. We had a long conversation with her expanded over the span of several weeks. Both in-person and over emails. During our conversation, we found out that she wanted something subtle and inspired by things she had seen online in the groups or pages she follows.

Upon interacting with our team installers, she eventually made a decision. She decided to get decals in the form of stripes on the sides of the Nissan Juke and on the back of both rearview mirrors. Although she wanted something very minimal and subtle, she wanted it to pop. That explains the colour she picked. She chose the “Gloss Atomic Teal 1080 – G356” by 3M.

It was an easy job for our installers and designers since these are the people who have been wrapping and designing vehicle wraps for more than a decade. While it is a tough job to install decals with perfection, it was quick and easy for our experienced installers.

Decals are the tattoos of cars:

If you look at it, decals are the tattoos for cars. When you’re done getting your first and are happy with it, you start looking to get another one. Similarly, in this case, our client was so happy with the job we did. She mentioned she will be getting a tattoo and since she was so satisfied with our job we threw in an idea to let her know we can turn whatever tattoo she gets, into a decal and install it on her Nissan Juke 2016. We showed her pictures of a similar job we did recently where we literally took an original drawing of a woman’s dragonfly tattoo and turned it into a decal. Check the pictures here.

After seeing what we did with the dragon tattoo, she assured us that she was definitely coming back.

No matter what it is that you want on your car, we at Vinyl Wrap Toronto can make it happen.

If you have any questions regarding vehicle wraps or decals, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our installers. Check out more of our work here.

blocks.html:
Mercedes GLE 350D – Matte Metalic Silver Racing Stripes

When you have a car that has started to show its age or simply does not interest you anymore. You’re left with two options and there’s no in-between. Either you could spice up the look of your car or get rid of it and get a new one.

Our recent client Mr. Hunter was in a similar dilemma. He was in a conundrum about his Mercedes GLE 350D. He could either fully wrap it or sell it and he had a plan for both of those situations. If he were to get a full wrap for his Mercedes GLE 350D, he had already decided on the design and colour of the material. All that was left was for him to make a decision.

After doing some thinking and discussing it with his spouse, he decided to do something entirely different than the original two options he couldn’t decide from. So, he figured out the happy middle ground which was to get racing stripes. Racing stripes won’t cost him as much as a full car wrap and is significantly cheaper than buying a new car.

For the stripes, he chose to go with the “Matte Metalic Silver”. The stripes go from front to back as well as on the sides and mirrors. Our installers started the work on the Mercedes GLE 350D and in no time it was done. Having been working in the vehicle wrap industry for more than a decade, installing decals is like squeezing lemons for our installers. Our client’s satisfaction is the source that allows us to toot our own horn like that. We’ve attached pictures of the Mercedes GLE 350D with stripes on this page for you to see.

We know we have done our job well when the client starts referring us to their friends and family. After we installed stripes on Mr. Hunter’s Mercedes GLE 350D, he referred us to his friend who contacted us and already discussing his requirements with our team. On top of that Mr. Hunter is also considering bringing in his wife’s car for a full wrap.

We appreciate Mr. Hunter for referring us to other people. It was a great pleasure working with him and we hope to be working more with him in the future.

Things to keep in mind while getting racing stripes:

Before you make an impulsive decision about racing stripes, ask yourself these following questions:

  1. Do I really want this?
  2. Am I aware of all my options? Such as the colour and finishes available?
  3. Does the colour I picked, go with the colour of my car?
  4. Have I decided where to get the stripes on the car?
  5. Am I aware of the best quality material on the market?

If the answer to any of the above questions is still uncertain, we advise you to contact experts and clear out your doubts. You may call Vinyl Wrap Toronto at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9w1B4.

Our Team is always willing to discuss options and meet your needs.

To read more stories, please visit our blog page. Check out more of our work here.

blocks.html:
Dodge Caravan – Custom Full Wrap

We see vehicles every single day. So much that we actually don’t even pay attention to the details. We just instinctively know that they’re there. People only pay attention to something that stands out.

For businesses that are extending their branches towards new projects, this can be a blessing in disguise. What’s better than an eye-catching vehicle spreading the word about the business on the road? “RockBottom Construction” is one of our oldest returning clients. In the past, we’ve wrapped several of RockBottom Construction trucks and vans.

Getting those wraps done for their company vehicles, bringing more business to them and now they’re looking to expand their business by adding another module; RockBottom Basements. Which is essentially a basement renovation service. To kick-start the project they decided the best approach is to take the necessary steps to make sure people recognize their brand.

They wanted to wrap their Dodge Caravan Van to show off their new endeavour. To make the custom full wrap happen, our designers and their team worked together very closely to render the vision they had in their minds. We started off by designing their company logo; “RockBottom Basements”. The logo is an essential graphic that represents the business everywhere. So, it requires a lot of thought and revisions to chisel it down to perfection. Which is exactly what our designers and our client did. Sat down and revised the logo until it made sense.

After the logo was done, the client had some images of previous work that they wanted to use on the Dodge Caravan’s Full Van Wrap. Similar to logo design, designing the mockup for a vehicle wrap requires both the client and designers to work together to revise and modify elements. Our designers, after a couple of revisions with the client, rendered the client’s perfect wrap design for the Dodge Caravan.

The complexity of design solely depends on how complex the design is and how well the client can explain their vision. For everything that has not been specified, there is a lot of brainstorming until the desired results are achieved.

The client provided us with the images they wanted to use, and our team designed it in a way that for sure will pull focus when the Dodge Caravan is out on the roads.

For the wrap, we used “Gloss Dark Grey (SW900)”, Printable Vinyl & Laminate offered by Avery Dennison. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we always use quality material provided by Avery Dennison & 3M because when it comes to our clients’ pride and joys, there are to be no compromises with the quality.

If you wish to get your car, van, truck, motorcycle, or basically anything wrapped, give our team a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to see us in action.

blocks.html:
Chevrolet Ambulance Custom Full Wrap | HepCURE

When we say we can wrap any vehicle, we mean it. Our portfolio testifies for us. From small objects to large RVs, we have dabbled into wrapping almost everything. Adding to the list of vehicles we transformed into pieces of art, we recently wrapped this Chevrolet Ambulance for HepCure.

HepCURE is a non-profit organization supporting community agencies and service organizations to optimize access and treatment services for marginalized patients requiring Hepatitis C treatment.

People at HepCURE wanted to spread awareness about their cause and wanted to do it in a way that actually works. They contacted us and wanted to discuss a full wrap for their Chevrolet Ambulance. All they had was an idea of what they wanted. When it came to specifics, they were not really sure about a lot of the options. So, our team of expert designers worked hard and came up with more than 5 unique designs for wrapping the Chevrolet Ambulance.

The client chose the one that caught their eye the most. Incidentally, it was the design that was going to be a bit of a challenge for our installation team. Due to a lot of elements in the design that needed to connect perfectly and the graphics being very minimal, it was a complex job to get it right. But our installers’ hard work and experience gave them the confidence to take on the job and do it with absolute precision.

We used Printable Vinyl offered by Avery Dennison to print the custom design. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we only use quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M.

The wrap features a beautiful and minimal pattern going all around the Chevrolet Ambulance with their logo, slogan, contact number, and website featured on both sides. The rood, roof, and back feature their logo as well. We’ve attached pictures of the Chevrolet Ambulance on this page.

Custom Wraps:

Custom Wraps could be anything of your liking designed by a designer that is later printed on printable vinyl. It gives you the freedom to go wild with your imagination. Consider yourself an artist and the vinyl will become your canvas.

Over the years, based on our analysis we have seen that people want custom wraps for personal reasons and very rarely for commercial jobs. We have a team of designers that has years of experience and is ready to manifest your dream wrap into reality.

If you have a vehicle or even an object that could use a bit of vinyl goodness, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

blocks.html:
Dodge Caravan 2020 – Commercial Decals

There is never a wrong time to give back to the community and extend a helping hand to those in need. With the whole world fighting the pandemic, a lot of our soldiers have fallen down and it is our duty as humans to help them get back up and stand against the great reset.

There are community services dedicated to helping the needy but oftentimes people who are in need don’t have the resources to discover where these community services are located. In order to spread the word so our brothers and sisters who need help can locate these services, it is required to promote the service in a way that is accessible to everyone.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto recently had the pleasure of installing promotional decals for community service “The Salvation Army” which accept donations and uses them towards feeding and providing necessities to those in need. To be able to raise more money for these people, the people at The Salvation Army wanted to spread the word about what they were doing. It was a smart thing to do now, especially with the pandemic going on.

They chose to install a few minimal vehicle decals on their Dodge Caravan 2020 to make people aware of their existence and what they do for the less fortunate. We took the Dodge Caravan in a heartbeat and took great pleasure in doing the job. It felt like we were doing our part to give back to the community.

The client(s) wanted a couple of promotional decals on the sides and the back. The decals feature their logo, address, phone number, and website. That covers all the information one would need to reach out to them. It was an initiative to attract both donors as well as people in need.

Having years of experience, we installed the decals on the Dodge Caravan 2020 in no time and we’re grateful that we were able to contribute to this noble cause.

We’ve attached some pictures of the Dodge Caravan on this page for you to see what the decals look like.

Most of our clients choose to go with decals/ vinyl stickers due to the following reasons:

  1. The target audience doesn’t need a device or service to see your ad.
  2. It is a non-aggressive way to advertise.
  3. Vinyl Stickers last for years.
  4. Decals are cost-effective based on their lifespan.
  5. Vinyl Stickers are environment-friendly.
  6. Decals are customizable, the design, colour, and finish, allow you to turn anything into a 2D decal.
  7. Easily removable

If you wish to get decals to promote your business, feel free to reach out to our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to our experts about your requirements.

blocks.html:
Vehicle Unwrap; Your Guide to a Safe Unwrap – Expert Advice

It goes without saying that there comes a time when you have to unwrap your wrapped car. This could be because of a multitude of reasons. Although it seems as easy as squeezing a lemon, it actually is not. If you are thinking about doing it yourself, you might want to know what could possibly go wrong.

Before we jump into what could go wrong, one of our returning clients, a radio station “Z103.5” got some decals done by Vinyl Wrap Toronto. The decals were applied to a sponsored vehicle to do the job for a short period and after that, they were to be taken off. Our client was aware of the complications of the unwrapping process. One of the vehicles was the Kia Soul 2019 and another Kia Sorento 2019. We installed decals on both of these vehicles and also took them off without any damage.

When we say unwrapping isn’t easy, it is because there are a lot of factors that contribute to making the process harder than it seems. These include:

  1. The quality of wrapping material.
  2. The time it has been on the car.
  3. Whether your vehicle has gone under the knife (eg: Custom Paint Job)
  4. Whether there were chipped paint patches when you got the vehicle wrapped.
  5. How well you have maintained the wrap.
  6. Age of the car and possible Rust.

Now, with all those things in mind, the only thing that could go wrong is that you or an inexperienced person unwrapping your pride and joy may accidentally damage the colour of your vehicle. Saving a few bucks is never worth more than paying for a paint job. Unwrapping is a game for experienced professionals, who have been dealing with wrapping and unwrapping for years on all kinds of vehicles.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have wrapped countless vehicles over the last decade and unwrapped a fair share of those wrapped vehicles. We have seen cases where a client tried to do it himself or hired an amateur installer and in both cases, they ended up damaging the paint job of their vehicle. Over the years, the vinyl’s adhesive grows only stronger. A stronger grip between the paint and vinyl has the ability to peel off the paint with it. This generally happens when people get vinyl wraps of questionable material. So, it is very important that you get it done using quality material if you’re not looking to face problems when unwrapping it.

Just like wrapping, unwrapping requires undivided attention and a series of actions and tricks to get the vinyl off safely without hurting the car. We have experienced installers who know how it’s done. We give a 100% guarantee as long as the vehicle was wrapped by us. blocks.html:
Chrome Delete For Mercedes C300

Chrome Delete, in general, is something that most people won’t care about. However, when you are passionate about turning a car into your dream car, getting rid of those silver stripes usually takes a spot on your to-do list. It was a similar case for one of our clients, Mr. Nataniel.

He wanted to get rid of what he considered annoying i.e the silver chrome stripes because they came in the way of him having his car his way. He believed the silver didn’t complement his Mercedes C300’s full black beauty. So he decided to have them deleted (covered) with a colour that he believes goes with the colour of his car. The colour our client picked was “Gloss Black” from Avery Dennison’s SW900 Series to match the gloss black paint job.

Having received a lot of requests for chrome deletes, we can say that most of our customers go with “Gloss Black”.

Deleting chromes from the Mercedes C300 wasn’t a big deal for our experienced installers since they’ve been wrapping far larger vehicles and objects for more than a decade. It was quick for our team and the client got to drive home in his Mercedes C300 the same day. We’ve attached some of the Mercedes C300 on this page after the Chrome delete process.

Nathaniel chose gloss black to cover the chrome on his Mercedes C300. Is that the only option you have? Certainly Not. Experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto came forth to make you aware of your options while getting Chrome deleted. Let’s jump in:

  • Pick Any Colour: It doesn’t always have to be black. In fact, you can get any colour you wish from the colour spectrum. However, the reason why people get the chromes deleted is that they believe the silver is not going with the colour of the rest of the car. So what you decide to get to make your car more appealing, depends largely on the colour of your vehicle. In this case, our client wanted to go with the same colour and finish as the rest of his Mercedes C300.
  • Quick & Easy: Chrome Delete jobs is a quick option and can be done in a matter of a few hours as long as you know what you want and the material is available at the garage. When we say it’s quick and easy, we mean by professionals. For someone who hasn’t done it before it could result in a disaster. But rest assured you can drive your car back home with the chromes deleted within a few hours.
  • Explore different finish options: When you do wish to get a Chrome delete job, don’t forget to go through the different finishes available. The finish of the material can make your car look way better. Available finishes include Gloss, Matte, and Satin.
  • Tap into your pool of creativity: if you wish to go wild with your imagination, there is something you can do that people don’t generally go for when they get a Chrome delete job. It is to get a custom-printed pattern on the material. Yes, anything is possible at Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our showroom at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts. Check out more car wraps here.

blocks.html:
Ford F-250 Commercial Truck Decals

Promoting a business is a minefield. With countless ways to advertise or promote a business, it is normal to get confused. Especially when advertising isn’t free or quick. When you’re looking for ways to spread the word about your business there are some factors that affect the decision you end up taking. These include:

  1. What is your target audience? Their shared interests, behaviors, etc?
  2. What kind of business is it that you’re trying to advertise?
  3. How long do you want to keep promoting?
  4. How much are you willing to spend?

Once you have done your research and have the answers to the questions above, you’ll be able to make a better decision. Our recent client Mr. Harley must have done the same to figure out that he wanted to get some promotional decals on his Ford F-250 2017 truck.

Our client figured that vehicle decal would be the best way to promote his business for the following reasons:

  1. Truck Decals are extremely customizable; There is no design that you can not turn into a decal.
  2. Truck Decals last for several years. You get the decals and forget about them.
  3. Vehicle Decals require minimal maintenance.
  4. Truck Decals are very cost-effective considering their lifespan.
  5. In most cases, truck decals are very easy to install and remove for professional installers.
  6. You get to choose from a wide spectrum of available colours and finishes, such as gloss, matte, brushed, etc.

Based on the above-mentioned information about decals, our client reached a decision to get decals to promote his business using all that extra/available real estate on his Ford F-250 2017 Truck.

He contacted our team and explained what he expected out of it. We gathered all the information and created a digital mockup to show him how the decals will look like on his Ford F-250 Truck. Once he approved we started to print and cut the vinyl. Laminated it and passed it to our capable installers. The decals were installed on both sides and back of the Ford F-250 truck, able to be seen from all directions.

We do all of our jobs with great enthusiasm, accuracy and treat our clients’ vehicles with the utmost respect and care.

We have attached pictures of the Ford F-250 truck after getting the decals on this page.

If you are looking to promote your business using your vehicle, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to make it happen. Feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

blocks.html:
Chevrolet Express 2010 Full Van Wrap – Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Wrapping is like a muscle, the more you practice the better you get at it. However, there always comes a time when you think a job is easier than it seems but it ends up taking more time than usual. Our returning client from “RockBottom Construction” recently bought this Chevrolet Express 2010 van. Although it was new to him, it has been around the block for a lot longer.

The client wanted to use the Chevrolet Express 2010 to advertise their business with a custom-designed full wrap. Only we didn’t have to design the wrap this time because it was an exact replica of the wrap we had previously done for one of their vans. We just simply had to print the vinyl without any sort of modification or resizing since both vans were basically identical. All in all, it seemed like a very easy and quick job. We used quality printable vinyl offered by Avery Dennison for the wrap. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto we only use the best quality material by Avery Dennison & 3M. We believe the quality and durability of a service is the key to customer satisfaction.

That is where we were proven wrong. Not because of our fault, but other complications. As we started to lay the vinyl on the Chevrolet Express 2010 it ripped off a huge chunk of paint from the van and BOOM! What was nice and easy became an unpleasant situation. Upon investigation, we found out that the van had gone through a refinish of the paint before the client bought the vehicle. And clearly, it wasn’t a job well done.

We organized with the client to send the Chevrolet Express 2010’s paint to be taken care of properly. By the time we got that done, this job had already surpassed the usual amount of time our experienced installers take for a full van wrap. Once we got the refinished vehicle back, we did our job with the same enthusiasm and precision as always.

Tips for when you’re getting a second-hand vehicle wrapped

Since the Chevrolet Express 2010 has been on the roads for a decade, it was bound to go through some touch-ups. So, as a buyer, always make sure to ask the necessary questions from the seller before you decide to get it wrapped. Questions like:

  1. Has the car gone through a custom paint job or any type of refinishing?
  2. If it has, then from where and what material/paint was used?
  3. Has the vehicle been previously wrapped or decaled?
  4. If yes, then from where and what material was used?
  5. How long has it been wrapped?

These are some essential questions to ask your seller before buying a vehicle that you want to get wrapped. Without the required information, you may end up in a similar situation to the Chevrolet Express 2010.

blocks.html:
Honda Odyssey Van Decals

When you run a business that requires you or your company personnel to visit a client’s location to do the job, you have an excellent opportunity to promote your brand that hides in plain sight. Which is to get your company’s promotional decals on your work vehicles. Vehicle decals are variable-sized custom-designed (often) vinyl stickers that stick to the surface of your vehicle. The purpose of getting decals can be anything, whether it is personal or commercial.

Our recent client who owns the business “Yachtmen’s Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning” came to know about the power of having a couple of decals on a vehicle. The client wanted his company’s promotional decals on his Honda Odyssey Minivan. He looked up vehicle wrapping shops in the area and that’s how he found Vinyl Wrap Toronto. Upon contacting us, he explained what he wanted and we took in all the details and assured him that the job is as good as done. We gave him many options from full wrap to partial to just decals depending on his vision and what he preferred. The owner wanted to make the decals understated rather than in your face, so chose to put the decals on the back window and side back windows of his vehicle.

Being in the Vehicle wrapping business for over a decade, installing a couple of decals on the Honda Odyssey was no big deal for our capable installers. After taking the order, our designers converted the client’s vision into a digital mockup. Once the client approved the design, we started to print the decals on the best quality material available on the market; Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl and laminated it using Avery Dennison’s lamination film. Vinyl Wrap then cut it using our modern and precise machinery, and finally weeded the unnecessary parts. After doing all that we passed the van decals onto our installers for installation.

Installing decals on the Honda Odyssey Minivan or any vehicle can be a real pain in the neck for someone who doesn’t have experience. One wrong move can leave you with bubbles, creases, improper alignment and more. This is why it is better to get them installed by trained professionals who know their way around working with vinyl.

Why did the client decide to get decals on his Honda Odyssey?

It isn’t just one reason, the list of perks is pretty long

  1. Van decals are a non-aggressive way to effectively advertise a business.
  2. Having decals on a van basically turns your vehicle into a moving billboard, covering a larger number of people who see your ad every single day.
  3. Van decals are cost-effective as compared to online advertising and twice as useful.
  4. You have the power to get anything turned into a vehicle, whatever you can think of can be printed as a decal; there are no limits on imagination.
  5. Van decals last for years, not like spending money on monthly ad campaigns.
  6. Decals do not hard your vehicle in any way, if anything they protect the surface on which they’re applied.
  7. Van decals are super easy to install and remove (by professionals).

Do you have a Honda Odyssey or any other vehicle that you wish to turn into a moving billboard advertising your business wherever it goes? Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to make it happen.
