Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s Top 5 Picks For Personal Full Car Wraps

Car wraps have become a thing and over the years we’ve had the pleasure to do a lot of full car wraps and each of them has been a marvellous piece of work. However, there are always the ones that stick out the most and it all depends on people’s perspectives. We asked our staff members and narrowed the list down to our 5 best full-car wraps of all time. We’re listing down the vinyl wraps in no particular order. Here are the gems:

1. Audi A4 2006 Sandstone Car Wrap:

Seems a bit odd when you hear it but it makes total sense when you look at the masterpiece. It was a custom wrap and initially, the client wanted a camouflage design, but later he came across a beautifully wrapped BMW and made the decision to go with a sandstone design and get some decals on top. The client got some of his favourite quotes on top of the full car wrap for his Audi A4 which goes on to show how you can show off what’s close to your heart. Check the blog post here for the detailed story.

2. Tesla Model 3 2020 – Satin Black Car Wrap:

Oh! What a beauty. The client wanted to get his white Tesla Model 3 fully wrapped with Satin Black Vinyl and Boy was that a great decision. A car that already stole everyone’s attention with its white colour. To make heads turn, we wrapped the Model 3 with Satin Black Vinyl which is not a factory option from Tesla. When you look at the fully wrapped car it’s hard to look anywhere else. Now that’s making a statement. Read the full story here.

3. Volkswagen Beetle Cinderella Themed Full Car Wrap:

When we say you are the artist and your car is your canvas, we mean it. One of our clients used their Volkswagen Beetle to live out their Disney fantasy. The client wanted a custom-designed Cinderella-themed wrap and it was one of the most interesting and unique full wraps we’ve done. The full car wrap features the classic Cinderella Blue theme along with elements like the mice, and the castle and later on we also wrapped the interior of the car with a beautiful Cinderella-themed design. See More Pictures Here:

4. Honda Civic 2010 Gloss Black Rose Car Wrap:

A full car wrap is key to changing the colour of your car. A car that has been around the block for a long time starts to show its age and this was exactly the case with this Honda Civic 2010. So, instead of going ahead and getting a custom paint job that has a lot of limitations, the client decided to make a statement with a bold colour choice. Read the full story here.

5. Nissan Rogue 2014 Full Wrap with Stripes:

A Full wrap does not mean you can only use one colour or finish of vinyl and this client chose the perfect combination of colours and a mix of Metallic and Gloss finishes to get their Nissan Rogue fully wrapped. The colours she chose complimented each other and the stripes on the hood were the cherry on the cake. See more pictures of the wrapped Rogue here.

Disclaimer: Wraps on this list have been picked by our staff. It was difficult to narrow down the list. People have different tastes and the list may not make sense for someone whose idea of beauty is different from ours.

If you are looking for a full car wrap, whether personal or commercial, please feel free to give us a call or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts regarding car wrap cost or anything else.

blocks.html:
Dodge Caravans & Mercedes Sprinter Fleet Van Decals

In a world full of countless businesses trying to compete with each other it becomes a challenge to come up with ways to effectively spread awareness about your business. In order for it to work, you need to figure out a way to do it in a way that will make people want to check out your services or products. This is what advertising companies have been trying to achieve for years.

The last thing you want to do is to pay for an online ad that either gets no traction or no return. Although the idea seems promising, it never works out as well as you think it will. Why? Ask yourself, when was the last time you were happy to see an ad interrupt your favourite tv show or article? Exactly! Every day people see countless ads online which interrupt their web surfing experience. So, adding to that and aggressively making people look at your ad will do you more harm than benefit.

Want to know what is a great and effortless way to promote your business without forcing people to look at your ad? Vehicle Decals. Turn your vehicle into a billboard on wheels. Our recent client knew about this brilliant way to boost his business recognition which is why he didn’t think twice before getting vehicle decals for his whole fleet.

The client owns a business called “I & J Contracting Inc”. His fleet included three Dodge Caravans and one Mercedes Sprinter. He wanted to keep it minimal because while you’re on the road no one is really like “Hmm wait let me stop here in the middle of the road to read all that text written on that vehicle”. Promotional van decals or lettering are supposed to be short and to the point.

Tips for getting promotional van lettering & decals:

  • Keep it short and catchy.
  • Make the lettering large enough to be read easily.
  • Use easy-to-read fonts.
  • Provide contact details such as phone, email, or website.
  • The sides and back are optimal spots for getting van decals or lettering.

We’ve attached pictures of the Dodge Caravans and Mercedes Sprinter on this page for you to see what the outcome is.

blocks.html:
Dodge Ram 1500 Truck Decals – Green Escapes Construction LTD

To be able to run a business requires smart and practical thinking. For things like, where and what to invest in, what products to promote, and how and when to promote the products. A successful business owner knows the execution of these actions must be accomplished keeping the target audience in mind. Among other things such as your industry, budget and goal.

One of our returning customers, “Green Escapes Construction LTD” knows how to grab a perfect opportunity to advertise a brand for a long time with just a one-time payment. Green Escapes Construction LTD had recently got commercial decals for their Ford F-250 truck to advertise their business. Since they see the potential in promoting a business using truck decals, they brought in another one of the trucks that they use for their Ice management and removal side of the business.

The reason our clients return to us with more job requests is that we give it our all. We use the best quality material available on the market and install it via the capable hands of our installers. The decals we installed on our client’s Ford F-250 proved to be beneficial and it only makes sense to grab the opportunity for other company vehicles that they have.

The company uses the Dodge Ram 1500 to sprinkle salt on Ice or remove it in the mornings and then the truck just sits there all day till the next morning. The client saw a chance, a chance to use all that extra real estate on the Dodge Ram 1500. What’s better than having a Dodge Ram 1500 with nothing on it? A Dodge Ram 1500 truck with commercial decals on it, promoting your business while it’s out at work or simply parked in front of your shop. In regards to this vehicle, we spotted it at the local hardware store multiple times. Proving that the decals stand out.

The truck decals, like most commercial decals, were simple and to the point. With a logo that pops, services offered and contact information. Having all that on your truck makes it the moving billboard that advertises your business wherever it goes. We used quality material offered by Avery Dennison to print and laminate the decals. We’ve attached pictures of the Dodge Ram 1500 on this page before and after the installation of truck decals and lettering.

Why Truck Decals?

Let’s say you have a marketing budget of $1000. The question is how you use the money. Do you buy online ads, flyers, brochures, update your website or get vinyl decals to promote your business? And if you choose any of these options, how do you spend it on online ads, tv or newspaper ads or do you choose something that lasts a lot longer? Any sane person would want something that lasts a lot longer for the same amount of money that would boost you for just a day or two. Truck Decals unlike other modes of advertisements, give you full control over the design and size and last for years.

You’re the boss and there are no restrictions on the kind of font, logo and amount of information you can include. Those are just a few of the benefits of truck decals and lettering. To learn about all the benefits, check our previous blog post about decals, here.

If you have a truck that you believe could be the moving billboard for your company or business, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts about your requirements and get a quote on truck decals cost.

RAM Promaster Cargo Van – Commercial Partial Wrap

It’s 2021 and a fresh new chapter in everyone’s journey to a successful Business. Vinyl Wrap Toronto Wishes everyone a very happy new year! Most people start to prepare to set their goals by the end of the year so they can enter the new year all set to work towards achieving them. One of our recent clients “N.E.G. Inc”; a business that provides audio, visual, lighting and CCTV services wanted to start the year 2021 on the right foot. Which is by investing in something to promote their business.

Considering the technological advancement, there are countless ways they could’ve advertised their business. But which one is the best? To figure that out they had to ask themselves the following questions:

  1. How much to spend?
  2. How long do you want the advertisement to last?
  3. What is the target audience?
  4. What is the nature of our business?
  5. What will give the best return?
  6. Which market to advertise in; Online, Paper-Based, Billboards?

The client owns a RAM Promaster Cargo Van which they use to carry out their daily business duties. Considering the pros of getting a vehicle wrap, the client decided to get a partial van wrap for their RAM Promaster Cargo Van to advertise their business. The client was very specific about what was required as the outcome and supplied their own design. Our designers converted the design into a digital mockup which we could use to print the design onto the best quality printable material provided by Avery Dennison. Vinyl Wrap Toronto only uses the best quality wrap material offered by 3M and Avery Dennison because when it comes to our clients’ pride and joys, there are to be no compromises.

After the printing and lamination process, it was passed on to our expert installers who do the real magic and put the vinyl onto the vehicles. This was a partial wrap with decals because the customer still wanted the original white colour on the van. The wrap covers more than half of both sides and the back of the RAM Promaster Cargo Van. We’ve attached pictures of the RAM Promaster Cargo Van on this page for you to see what it turned out to look like.

When you’re getting commercial wraps and decals, our experts have the following advice to give you:

  1. Keep It Simple – Less is more; especially when it’s something that’s supposed to be read while driving.
  2. Use an easy-to-read font.
  3. Keep the font large enough so can be seen from a distance.
  4. Use colours that pop.
  5. Include contact information such as phone, email, and website.

blocks.html:
Ford Transit Wrap – Full custom-designed van wrap

Starting a new business sure is a lot to handle. From creating an identity for your business to providing reasonably priced services, everything requires a strategy. Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s recent client, owner of Kick & Tech wanted to begin the journey towards success as the new year begins. The client owns a mobile gadget repair business. The business operates mostly on wheels. They receive an order and go to their clients to fix their phones, laptops, consoles, etc.

Being a mobile business, there is without a doubt a vehicle (Ford Transit Van) that they use to carry out their business duties. Now, the smart thing to do here would be to realize that all that extra space on the company vehicle can be used to promote the business as it hits the roads. The client realized that and contacted Vinyl Wrap Toronto explaining his vision.

A client’s vision is all we need to get our gears grinding and start the design process. Originally the client placed an order for a custom-designed van wrap for a Ford Transit Connect but later upgraded it to a larger sized vehicle i.e. Ford Transit. So, we had to make a few adjustments because of the size differences.

Regardless of the size difference, it was a fully custom-designed van wrap by our experienced designers. The original design was inspired by a shattered phone screen, something the client deals with daily. The client took a look at the design created for his Ford Transit and made a few revisions before it was finalized. After the client approved the design, we printed it using premium quality printable vinyl material offered by Avery Dennison and laminated it. Later on, it was passed on to our experienced installers.

Installation is the most tricky and important part of the job because otherwise, it’s just a design printed on vinyl. What makes it a wrap is when it is actually laid on the surface of a vehicle and that requires attention to detail and a firm hand. In this case, as our installers started to wrap the Ford Transit, they came to realize that the client had forgotten to make sure that there are no rusty spots or chipped paint on the vehicle. We cannot wrap over rust or damaged areas as they will either fail or not adhere. Meaning the customer will be disappointed and not return.

We ask our customers to make sure that there no rust spots and paint chipping on the vehicle because it makes the wrapping process a lot more complicated. The presence of rust and paint chipping can cause more damage to the paint and causes the vinyl to not lay down on the surface properly. So, it is very important to make sure the vehicle does not have any of those issues and if does, they need to be taken care of before the vehicle is dropped off for a wrap.

Upon spotting the issue we informed the client. He took care of the issue and dropped it back at our garage. From that moment onwards, our installers took over and worked their magic. We’ve attached some pictures of the wrapped Transit Connect on this page for you to see what the final outcome looks like.

Here’s what our installers advise for when you want a promotional wrap for your vehicle:

  • Keep it simple yet eye-catching: A full van wrap is your opportunity to turn your vehicle into your artistic canvas and show off your business in its full glory. The advice by installers is to keep it simple yet attractive enough to look at.
  • Use easy-to-read fonts: Our installers would advise you to pick a font that is easily readable. It is important because while on the road, people can not put too much strain on trying to read something that’s also moving.
  • Include contact information: A promotional van wrap is worth nothing if it does not include all the ways customers can reach you. Use the space to include phone, email, website, and even social media.

Do you wish to advertise your business using your company or personal vehicles? Give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts regarding van wrap cost, vinyl materials, etc.

Ford Transit Connect Commercial Van Decals

When you want to advertise your business or products, one of the best and most effective ways to do it is via the help of decals that go on the surface of your vehicle to be seen by people when you’re on the road. Our recent client wanted to get some vinyl decals and lettering on his Ford Transit Connect Minivan. The purpose was simply to promote their business.

The client chose to get decals and lettering for his Ford Transit Connect based on the following factors:

  1. Van Decals and Lettering allow you to be creative without design limitations; as long as it can be designed, we can turn it into decals or lettering and install it on your vehicle.
  2. For decals and lettering, you get to pick from a wide spectrum of colours.
  3. You can pick from a number of available finish styles such as satin, gloss, matte, etc.
  4. It is a non-aggressive way to advertise because you’re not interrupting anyone to show them your ad.
  5. Van decals last for years, meaning you don’t have to pay those daily/weekly/monthly campaign charges that you would normally do on an online ads campaign.
  6. Cost-effective considering the lifetime and minimal maintenance.
  7. You turn the vehicle into a moving Billboard

The customer wanted to go for something very simple, which is to get commercial decals all around his Ford Transit Connect Van. Decals including his company logo, slogan, contact number and website. The client consulted with our team and we were more than happy to take in the job.

For the decals, we used Avery Dennison’s printable vinyl and laminate. We only use what we consider to be the best quality material available on the market which is Avery Dennison & 3M. The design called for the decals to go on both sides, the hood and the back of the Ford Transit Connect. Installing these decals was no big deal for our expert installers. We have attached pictures of the Ford Transit Connect on this page for you to see what the van decals look ended up looking like.

We knew the client was happy with our service because he also placed an order to get custom branded corporate apparel done by Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s partner Workwear Toronto.

Over the years, we’ve installed decals and wrapped a lot of these Ford Transit Connect vans. Each one of them has a different style of decals that helped them stand out.

blocks.html:
Vehicle Decals for Fleet

Like we haven’t already been saying on this website since it was published, vehicle decals are one of the most cost-effective yet effective ways to advertise your business without being all up in others’ faces like other kinds of ads. Our recent client who owns the business called “B & E Construction” was aware of what a couple of decals can do for a business and that was the reason why he decided to get vinyl decals and lettering for four of his company decals. The vehicles include:

  • Dodge Caravan
  • Ford E450
  • GMC Savana
  • Chevrolet Silverado

The client wanted something very simple and easy to read on his vehicles. He just wanted his company logo featured on each side of the above-mentioned vehicles. Since it was just his company logo, it was super easy for our designers to create the mockup. The installation, similarly, was equally as easy for our experienced vinyl wrap installers. All four of the vehicles had the same kind of decals and lettering, which shows this client believed “less is more”. We used Avery Dennison’s material for printing and laminating the decals for B & E Construction.

Reasons to get vehicle decals:

  • It helps you promote your business and creates a visual image in people’s heads that relates to your company name.
  • Vehicle decals are relatively cheap considering their lifespan as opposed to digital ad campaigns.
  • You are the master and your vehicle is your canvas; You have full freedom to get anything turned into a decal. As long as it can be designed and printed, it can be the decals on your vehicle.
  • Decals and lettering last for years once installed.
  • Vinyl decals and lettering require minimal maintenance.
  • It is a non-aggressive and effective way to promote a business because you are not interrupting anyone like an online ad.

Pro tips while getting decals:

  • Keep it simple; sometimes less is more.
  • Choose a font that’s easy to read; consider something that’s legible while your vehicle is on the road.
  • Include contact information; give people something to reach out to you such as a phone number, email, website, etc.
  • Make it pop; this may seem to contradict the first point to keep it simple, but that’s not the case, simple can pop if it’s done right. It requires creativity and choosing a colour combination that will attract people on the road to read what’s written on your vehicle.

Apart from vehicle decals we also offer the following services at Vinyl Wrap Toronto:

  • Full Vehicle Wrap
  • Partial Wrap
  • Boat Wrap
  • Object Wrap
  • Motorcycle Wrap
  • Interior wrap or decals
  • Graphic design
  • Signs
  • Wall Graphics
  • Storefront Signs

We wrap all kinds of vehicles and objects including cars, trucks, vans, boats, motorcycles, bicycles, guitars, urns, and so much more. Our motto is, if it has a surface, we can wrap it.

If you wish to promote your business by turning your fleet into your moving billboard or have a query regarding vehicle wrap cost, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

blocks.html:
680 News | Toyota Highlander Hybrid

A successful business owner knows how to grab every opportunity to take the company to the next level. In any case, it requires creative ideas that show your brand off to raise awareness. If you are not doing anything to promote your business, then there you’re holding your business back from its true potential. The more effort you put into advertising, the more potential customers you reach.

One of the leading news companies in Toronto called “680 News” is on the right track for advertising its brand. Being a successful news portal, one would think that’s enough. But 680 News is putting an effort into promoting their brand each day and it’s certainly paying off. The company wanted to do something to advertise and show off their brand that would stay for a long time. What kind of promotional object or service is durable enough to last for years with just a one-time payment? We have the answer for you, vehicle wraps.

680 News placed an order to get 3 of their new Toyota Highlander Hybrids fully wrapped to promote their business. All three of the Toyota Hybrid Highlander Hybrids were to be wrapped in the exact same design and material. For the full wrap, the company chose the colour Kelly Green because it is the colour of the 680 News logo.

On top of the Kelly Green full car wraps, we installed some white-coloured decals and lettering. For the full wrap, we used material offered by 3M and for the decals, we used Avery Dennison. The client had a picture of the colour they wanted to get, but the issue with using a picture as a reference as opposed to a physical object is that the picture tends to shift colours based on which screen it is being displayed. Our team tried to give the client as much colour accuracy as possible. On the full wrap, it features the company logo on both sides in big bold letters and a sponsorship message for “Toyota”.

Our experienced installers have years of wrapping vehicles under their belts, but practice makes perfect so by the third Hybrid Toyota, our team was flying through the install.

We have attached pictures of the Toyota Highlander Hybrids on this page for you to see what they look like after the wrap.

This is not the first time when we wrapped a hybrid vehicle, but we did learn a few things while we were going through the process.

Here are the steps or tasks we go through to fulfill a vehicle wrap order:

  • Gather requirements from the client.
  • Start designing the wrap based on the information provided by the client; the time spent varies depending on the complexity of the design.
  • Create a mockup file for the client.
  • Send mockup to the client and wait for approval.
  • If the client doesn’t approve, make the revisions and send the file again.
  • Upon approval, start the printing and lamination process.
  • Get the vehicle ready by cleaning it with vinegar and alcohol.
  • Installation
  • Inform the client and have the vehicle picked up.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding vehicle wrap cost, vinyl wrap materials, etc., feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak with one of our experts.

Lexus SC430 – Coupe; Full Car Wrap

It is human nature to get bored with the things we have. Sure, the excitement is at its peak when we get a brand new car but we all know it fades over time. So naturally, we look for ways to either freshen up the look of the car or get a new one. Since getting a new one can be a bit damaging for your pocket, what most of us end up doing is adding our personal touch to make the car interesting again.

In this blog, we’re going to talk about the story of a father and daughter with a car that went through a makeover through the hands of our experts working at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. Every wrap request has a source of inspiration and a story. Inspiration for something can strike from anywhere. It gives us immense pleasure to get to know these stories that lead our customers to get a vinyl wrap. In this case, The father had this Lexus SC430 for about 2 decades. The Lexus SC430 was one of a few cars he had in his collection. Judging from what we saw, we can say that the man has great taste when it comes to vehicles.

After having this car for several years, the father gave his Lexus SC430 to his daughter. The daughter took over the car and had been driving it for the last 10 years. Now that she was about to be blessed with a child. Her natural parental instincts kicked in and she realized that she wanted something that was a bit more baby-friendly. Since the Lexus SC430 she had was a coupe. It really wasn’t going to be that useful to her anymore. So, she decided to return the car back to her father.

Her father is a man who constantly looks for inspiration to make his car collection one of a kind. Now that he got his Lexus SC430 back, he felt it needed to be revived with a brand new look. The car had been around the block for about 2 decades and it makes sense that he was bored out of his mind for the way it looked. His Lexus SC430 originally had a factory standard silver colour, which is basically a go-to colour for every car manufacturer on the market.

Being a car enthusiast, the father was very active in social media car groups. This is where he saw someone else’s Lexus SC430 and he immediately had his heart set on getting something similar for his Lexus. He looked for vinyl wrap agencies in his area and decided to contact us due to our customer reviews and excellent portfolio. Upon receiving his request, we were immediately impressed by the man’s creative vision and decided to take on the job.

What he wanted to get was a full car wrap for his Lexus SC430. The colour and finish he wanted were a glossy Indigo. What’s so special about that? You may be wondering. The interesting choice was to add one red stripe from the nose to the tail. We’re sure that reading it in the text doesn’t seem like it’s something to hype about. This is why we’re attaching a couple of pictures of the wrapped car for you to see.

The material we used to wrap his Lexus SC430 was Avery Dennison’s SW900 Glossy Indigo. Because when it comes to wrapping our clients’ pride and joys, there is to be no compromise with quality. Of course, using quality material means nothing if the installers aren’t experienced enough. Fortunately for the father, he did his research before contacting us and knew that we have experienced certified installers working with us. Our installers did a marvellous job giving this beauty a complete makeover. The results were as always breathtaking and we’re saying it with confidence because the client left with a big smile on his face. The daughter was also so impressed, she introduced us to her husband who was looking to add stripes to his Mustang.

So that was the story of a client who wanted to freshen up the look of his Lexus SC430 and at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we manifested his vision into reality.

If you’ve got a vehicle that you want to personalize with your own unique style. Give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our showroom located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, On, M9W1B4. We’d be glad to answer your queries regarding car wrap cost/price, vinyl materials used etc.

Ford F150 Commercial Truck Decals

In Canada, almost every business has a car or a vehicle that they use to carry out their business duties. While there’s a vehicle with a lot of marketing real estate on it, why not use it to promote your business? A smart business person knows how to use every resource they have in order to make the business more recognizable. One way to make sure that everyone knows your business is to get vehicle decals.

When it comes to decals the possibilities are limitless. Our recent client owns a successful painting business called “Mer-Gon Painting”. The client uses a Ford F150 truck to go from one site to another and he saw the opportunity to make sure that everyone sees what his business is about and he took it. What could be better than mobile advertising that you only pay for once? He brought his Ford F150 truck to Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s garage and talked to our installers about his requirements.

As for his requirements, they were simple. He wanted something very simple and easy on the eyes. It’s a couple of decals that go on both sides as well as the back of the Ford F150 truck. The decals feature the company’s logo with the contact number. Plain and simple.

The reason why getting simple decals is considered effective is because they’re easy to read for others while you’re on the road driving.

For the truck decals, we use Avery Dennison’s Printable vinyl and laminate. The installation process was very easy for our expert installers since they have years of experience wrapping vehicles.

We’ve attached pictures of the Ford F150 truck with the decals on this page for you to see what the truck decals look like.

Here are some quick tips when you’re thinking of getting truck decals:

  • Keep it simple.
  • Use easy-to-read fonts.
  • Make decals large enough to be clearly seen.
  • Include contact information.
  • Include a unique element that pulls the focus.

If you have a vehicle that you could use to advertise your business or would like to enquire about truck decal cost, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

blocks.html:
Goodmen Corporation Fleet Truck Decals:

In the 21st century, things have changed. What worked a few years ago, doesn’t work today as well. When you’re in business and want to keep your brand growing. It is important to keep yourself up to date with the latest trends in the market.

Because when it comes to marketing, the basic rule is to create something that catches the potential client’s eye without annoying them or disrupting their thought process. So when you’ve made up your mind about marketing your business. There are countless directions you can steer into.

Most forms of marketing can be costly, but done right can grow your business. Almost any approach you pick to advertise will have one flaw and it’s almost impossible to not let it happen. That is annoying people with your ad. Yes, we said it. When was the last time you saw an ad and were actually interested in what it’s about? Exactly. Especially when your plan is to advertise over the internet what ends up happening is you don’t get your money’s worth and little to no rise in the number of your customers.

However, there is a way you can advertise your business without making people cringe. It is by getting your advertisements on your personal or company vehicles. With a few decals, you can turn your fleet vehicles into moving billboards, spreading the word wherever they go.

A local company named “Goodmen Corporation” contacted us to get some truck decals on their fleet to promote their business. The company uses a variety of vehicles such as the Ford F150, Ford F250, Ford E350XL, etc. It was a couple of decals on the sides and roof of each truck that the company uses to carry out its services.

Originally what they wanted was to get decals only on the sides and back but not on the roof. Since our installers have been in the game for several years, we offer expert advice to our clients which is in their best interest. So we wanted the customer to see why they should consider getting decals on the roofs of the vehicles as well.

So, why should they have gotten decals on the roof? Simple, there are condos and buildings with multiple stories and people live and work on those upper floors. So they can’t really see the decals on the sides as well as they would see an ad on the top of your vehicle.

So while you’re getting decals all around your vehicle, you might consider some on the roof of your truck or fleet vehicle. So it would be like advertising from every angle. On top of that advice, we wanted them to actually see the roof with decals on it before they made a decision.

So we offered to install decals on one of the truck’s roofs for the client to see its value. After that, it was the client’s decision whether they wanted to go with decals on the roof or not. But since they saw potential in our advice, the client agreed to get truck decals on the roofs of the whole fleet.

The material we used to do the truck decals is Avery Dennison’s premium quality vinyl. The Decals were all custom-designed. The company uses different trucks and vans varying in size and body type. So, for each different vehicle, we had to resize the decals with respect to the size of the vehicle. But that wasn’t much of a problem for us because that’s what we do and we’re quite versatile.

So, when our professional designers accurately resized and rendered those decals on digital mock-ups. The next step was to print and cut the decals. We use industry-standard cutting equipment to ensure precision and this case was no exception. After we cut and pre-masked the truck decals, it was our installers’ turn to take over the next part of the process, installation. This is the main step where the vinyl decals were actually installed onto the fleet’s surface.

We have experienced installers working with us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. They wrap the car with the utmost respect and care for the client’s vehicle as if it’s their own. The outcome was as fruitful as our installers had already predicted and it was verified by the client’s satisfaction when they saw their wrapped fleet.

While we’re on the subject of decals, there are quite a lot of perks that make decals better than any other means of advertising:

  1. Cost-effective: Advertising isn’t cheap. You have to spend a sack of money before you can actually profit from it. However, decals when compared to any other mode of advertising, are incredibly cheap, especially if you consider their low maintenance.
  2. Longer Lifetime: Unlike other ways of marketing, decals don’t require you to pay a single buck for years. And after that, all you have to do is pay for new decals and you’re good to go for years again.
  3. Freedom to Imagine: Decals are custom-designed vinyl stickers which means you can get almost any design turned into decals as long as it can be designed. With our team of capable designers, that won’t be a problem. You get to pick from a large spectrum of colours and finishes.
  4. Non-aggressive Advertising: Unlike online ads, truck decals aren’t all up in people’s faces. This is why they’re considered a non-aggressive way of marketing because only the people who want to look at them, will look.

The above-written factors are what influenced our client to get truck decals for his fleet of Ford F150, Ford F250, Ford E350XL, etc.

If you’ve got a personal vehicle or fleet that you want to use to advertise your business, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to make it happen. If you have any questions or want a quote regarding truck wrap cost, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4. We’d love to have you over.

blocks.html:
5 Questions to ask when getting a car wrap

Car wraps or vehicle wraps allow people to transform their car into something that matches their vision. When it comes to car wraps there are no limitations on what design you can get. Think of your car as a blank canvas and yourself as an artist. Anything you can imagine can be turned into a design, printed on vinyl and installed on your car. A car wrap is a cost-effective way to make your car one of a kind.

You’d be surprised to see the kind of car wraps people get to express themselves. Car enthusiasts understand the thrill and joy of owning a car that turns heads and makes jaws drop. Now, this is not for everyone, but there is a growing number of extroverts using their vehicle to show their creativity.

So, let’s say you made up your mind about getting a car wrap. Before you go to the first shop and hand over your vehicle, here are a few things you should ask your potential wrap agency. Choosing the wrong company could result in a disappointing job and a damaged vehicle.

1. What material do you use?

This should be your first question and the answer to this should tell you whether it is your company or not. The market is full of various car wrapping materials. The quality of wrapping material determines its adhesive level, durability, lifespan, maintenance, removability and more. If you hear any of the following, you’re good.

  • 3M – Vinyl Wrap Toronto considers this the best quality material available on the market for when you want a colour change as well as a custom-designed and printed wrap. It has a wide collection of colours and finishes that you can choose from.
  • Avery Dennison: Another great option is to go with Avery Dennison. Apart from being one of the best quality materials, it is easy to install and remove.

If the wrap company you’re speaking to is using these materials, you shouldn’t worry about the material being used. Other Vinyl Wrap materials like Vivid are newer and considered good.

2. Would you clean my vehicle before installing the wrap?

Most vehicle wrapping companies will ask you to pop your vehicle through a car wash before you drop it off at their garage. Car washes don’t clean everything and for a car wrap to sit tightly on the surface of your car, it needs to be spotless. Most good vehicle wrap companies would clean your vehicle with alcohol and vinegar or similar. If you hear that as a response, they’re doing it right.

3. Will my vehicle be safe at your facility?

You’re dropping off your car at their facility and it is your duty to make sure it is in good hands. Your vehicle is going to be at their facility for several days, so be sure to ask them if you can trust them with the safety of your car. Ask them the following:

  1. Where will your vehicle be stored?
  2. Does the shop have an alarm system and security?
  3. Is the facility insured?
  4. Would they take responsibility in case of an accident?

If you’re satisfied with the response you get to the above-written questions, you can move on to asking the next question.

4. Do you only do a colour change or commercial vehicle graphics as well?

This isn’t a biggie but it sure does tell you a little more about the kind of quality you will get. If the wrap company has been in the business for about a decade designing custom commercial vehicle wraps, then a personal car wrap should be easy for them. But if they just do a colour change, you can assume there is less equipment and the company might as well be started by amateurs who learned how to wrap via youtube videos.

5. Can I See some of the work you’ve done?

Before you drop off your car for a wrap. First, see the kind of jobs that they have done in the past. Look for variety and creativity in their designs. While they’re fetching their records/portfolio, take a look around and see if they’re currently working on a vehicle to see them in action. If you’re satisfied with the answers you get from the company, you should be good to place the order for your car wrap.

blocks.html:
The perfect car wrap doesn’t exis…

It sure does if you get it done by Vinyl Wrap Toronto. In this article, we’re going to explain the process we follow to deliver a perfect car wrap or vehicle wrap to our clients.

Vehicle wrapping isn’t a child’s game, it’s something that requires years of practice and an understanding of a car’s body. Someone who can pay attention to every curve on a car’s body. That involves both installers and designers.

Here’s what we do when we receive an order for a car wrap:

1. Design:

Designing a car wrap isn’t as simple as designing a flyer where you can simply add your logo and text and it’s done. Cars aren’t flat like paper or banners. To be able to design a wrap for a car, the designer has to have experience and familiarity with the various curves on the car’s surface.

Apart from that, the designer must use the latest car outline and make sure the design will lay on the vehicle perfectly without being distorted or sliced into pieces. Imagine floating heads or missing graphics. Not considering every area and curve on the car’s body will result in a car wrap that looks different than what’s in the design template; and not in a good way. Showing a customer a design and not being able to reproduce it is not our thing. We have a team of graphic designers who are passionate about vehicle graphics and are capable of producing any kind of car wrap design as long as you can communicate your requirements with us.

2. Material:

The second most important thing is to decide which material to go with. After all, the material plays an important role in the quality and longevity of the wrap. We understand that. This is why we only use the best quality material offered by 3M & Avery Dennison for all our car wrap jobs. Both of these brands have a wide range of finishes and colours to choose from. We have tried other types of vehicle vinyl on the market, and prefer to work with these two.

3. Production:

Once our client approves the car wrap design and decides which material to go with, the next step in our process is to start production. This is where we actually print the design on the chosen vinyl material using our wide format industry standard printing equipment. Wide-format printing is not as simple as printing paper at home on your HP or Canon printer. What we do is a lot more complex. In order to print accurate colour and positioning, the machine has to be configured properly. Experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have been dealing with wide-format printing for almost a decade now.

4. Preparation:

The next step we take when we have the perfect design, material and print is to prepare the vehicle for installation. It is one of the most time-consuming processes in the car wrap job. We ask our clients to make sure the vehicle goes through a basic car washed before they drop it off at our garage. When the client drops off their car, our installers have to make sure that there is absolutely no dirt and wax on the car’s surface.

Because if there is dirt on the surface, it will get in the way of the vinyl’s adhesive sticking to the surface of the car and may result in unwanted air bubbles or cause the vinyl to lift off the surface. To make sure that does not happen, our installers clean every surface on the vehicle while they install the vinyl. Each installer has their own method and cleaning solutions in preparing the vehicle.

5. Facility:

After we have everything ready to wrap the car, the next thing is to make sure our facility is clean and spacious. We make sure that our garage is dust-free, has the right temperature, etc. Because having a facility with dust particles in the air will defeat the whole purpose of cleaning the car.

6. Installation:

This is where the real magic happens. Our installers take the printed material and start wrapping your car. This is the most important phase. The client couldn’t care less if the design or print is perfect, what the client wants is a perfect car wrap. Our installers are aware of how different materials behave and how to lay them down perfectly on the surface of a vehicle.

Apart from installation, our installers make sure all the excess material is properly cut out without causing a single scratch to your car. It requires a steady hand and a lot of concentration. Our installers have been working in the industry for years and know what they’re doing. So, you can rest assured, your car wrap will turn out to be exactly how you saw it on the design file.

blocks.html:
16-Foot 2007 Crestliner Boat Wrap

Boating season is just around the corner. It is time to take the boats out of your garages and set sail. When you have had the same boat for years, it is natural to get a little bored with the way it looks. Our recent client felt his boat needed to be freshened up a little bit. The client owns a 16 Foot 2007 Crestliner Boat.

The Crestliner Boat had started to show its age and needed a total makeover. So, the client contacted us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto and explained what he was looking for. The client came in to discuss his requirements and took a look at some camouflage patterns. He liked the idea of camouflage but wanted his own custom-designed pattern instead of using a factory-made design for his Crestliner Boat. It was an interesting job for our designers and it didn’t take them long to design a camouflage pattern and get the client’s approval.

Upon the client’s approval, we printed the design on Avery Dennison’s printable vehicle vinyl; we consider it one of the best wrapping materials available on the market. The printed wrapping material was then passed onto our experienced installers who wrapped the Crestliner Boat with absolute precision and detail. The camouflage pattern goes around the boat and we added a bit of an accent by wrapping the tire covers of the boat trailer.

Most of the time when people want to freshen up the look of their boat, they have two cheaper options other than buying a new boat. They can either get a boat wrap or get a custom paint job for their boat. Experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto want you to know the following things about boat wraps before you make a decision:

Why get a Boat Wrap instead of a custom Paint Job?

  1. Keep the Original Colour:
    This is one of the delicious perks of getting a boat wrap or any vehicle wrap. A wrap is essentially a layer of material that sits on top of your boat’s surface, preserving the original colour. Giving you the option to switch back to the original colour whenever you want.
  2. Freedom of expression:
    Unlike custom-paint jobs, boat wraps allow you to go wild with your imagination, and won’t cost you a fortune. Anything that you can describe to the designers can be turned into a boat wrap. Be it a solid colour, pattern or image, there are no limits on what you can get as a boat wrap. Additionally, you get to pick from several finishes such as satin, matte, gloss, etc.
  3. Cost-effectiveness:
    Considering the freedom of design, the ability to retain the original colour of your boat and the lifespan of boat wraps, it is considered a relatively cost-effective way of switching up the look of your boat. A paint job can start out relatively cheap for a single colour and more than triple for custom designs.
  4. Added Paint Protection:
     Not only do boat wraps let you keep the original paint of your boat, but also added protection for the paint from water, sun and debris. So, when you decide to take off the wrap years later, you’d see the paint underneath has remained intact.
  5. Lifespan:
    Once you get a boat wrap, you won’t have to worry about it for several years as long as they use premium quality material. Like a paint job, there is minimal maintenance required.
  6. Easy Installation and Removal:
     Wrapping a boat and unwrapping it is an easy process that can be finished in just a day by professionals.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding boat wrap cost, vinyl materials used or vehicle wraps in general, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage. We’re located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.

blocks.html:
5 Secrets to a Perfect Car Wrap

A car wrap is something that’s supposed to be on your car for years. This is why it is important that you take your time doing your research. So that you don’t end up with something that you will later regret in days/months/years. Here are a few tips that you need to follow for a great car wrap.

1. Choose a material that offers Protection:

No matter what kind of wrap you get, it will offer some level of protection due to the fact that it’s a layer that goes on top of your vehicle. If you choose a full car wrap, the protection will cover the whole vehicle, if you choose decals or a partial wrap the protection will only be where the vinyl is laid down. This does raise one issue; Ghosting. This is when you remove the decals or Partial wrap, the paint is in better condition than the rest of the vehicle.

2. Figure out your purpose:

Before you go and place an order, it should be clear to you whether the car wrap is supposed to be commercial or personal. If it is a promotional wrap, then make sure the design idea you have focuses on that. Put yourself in the shoes of your target customer. And if it is a personal wrap, then look for inspiration online and on-road while driving.

3. Spend time on your design:

The design is one of the most important phases of a car wrap; especially for you (the client). The wrap company will print anything you want. Since you’ll be stuck with the design for several years, make sure you take your time refining it till you are satisfied with what you see. We suggest printing out the proof and looking at it every day for a week to ensure you are extremely happy with the design.

4. Pick premium quality material:

When it comes to car wraps, you get what you pay for. If you’re looking for something durable and visually appealing then it goes without saying that you should go with the premium quality material. Avery Dennison & 3M offers the best quality material on the market. Additionally, you get to choose from their wide spectrum of colours and finishes such as satin, gloss, matte, etc.

5. Choose a good laminate:

Using premium quality vinyl for a car wrap would be for nothing if you choose to go with a laminate that’s considered to be low quality. Make sure to pick the matching laminate material that does not shift colour over time, and resists bubbles and external environmental factors.

#Bonus Tip:

When you’ve got your car wrapped, ask the wrap company for instructions on how to take care of the wrap. It doesn’t require much but there are certain things you can do to maintain your car wrap to add a bit of extra time to its lifetime.

If you’re looking to wrap your car, whether for commercial or personal purposes, give Vinyl Wrap Toronto a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of your experts regarding car wrap cost, materials used, etc.

blocks.html:
Disposal Bin – Custom-designed Vinyl Wrap

When it comes to grabbing an opportunity, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is always the first one. Our team consistently looks for smart marketing opportunities that will help us be more recognizable in the area.

So, it makes sense that we had to do something when we found out that our long-time returning client refinished this huge disposal bin for his company D&C Junk Removal Services. It was a great opportunity for us to show off our brand while also promoting our client’s business. Our team immediately broke the ice and discussed it with the client.

The client recently refreshed the disposal bin by painting it red and brought it to us to discuss a marketing strategy that kills two birds with one stone.

We settled on fully wrapping his disposal bin in a custom-designed vinyl wrap. The wrap features a picture of the company’s Porsche wrapped by Vinyl Wrap Toronto along with the client’s business contact information. It was a great opportunity for us to show off some of our work while also promoting our client’s business.

It is not every day that we get to wrap an entire disposal bin, so it was an interesting challenge for our designers to come up with a design that best utilizes every inch of the disposal bin to promote ours as well as our client’s business.

To print the wrap, we used premium quality printable vinyl and laminate offered by Avery Dennison. Since the disposal bin had raised edges on it, we had to play around with the material to make the picture shown in the wrap look as natural as possible. On the back, we installed decals and lettering showing off Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s as well as our client’s contact information.

Materials Used:

  • Avery Dennison 1105 Printable Vinyl
  • Avery Dennison 13602 Laminate

We’ve attached some pictures of the wrapped disposal bin for you to see how an ordinary disposal bin can be a billboard promoting your business.

Here are a few things you can do to make your promotional vinyl wrap stand out:

  • Say yes to Bright Colours: The purpose is to get noticed and bright colours will accomplish that for you. Do not hesitate to play with colours to make sure that all eyes are on your wrapped vehicle.
  • Keep it to the Point: Vehicles move very quickly and your vehicle wrap should be easy enough to send the message across within a few seconds. Do not use the wrap to write big paragraphs of text. A catchy one-liner can get you more business than 4 lines of formal text.
  • Use Premium Quality Material: Using a premium quality material will not only ensure that your vehicle wrap lasts for several years but also gives it a nice and chic look. People who know will immediately notice that you haven’t compromised on quality.
  • Be Creative: No one is going to be impressed if your vehicle looks like a typical wrap. Be weird, be funny, be bold or be anything that makes your vehicle wrap stand out, in a good way of course.

If you’re looking to get a vehicle wrap for personal or commercial purposes, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to turn your vision into reality. Feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts regarding any questions about vehicle wrap cost, and materials used or to discuss your requirements.

blocks.html:
Online/Paper-Based Advertising Vs Fleet Decals:

Depending on the type of business, it is essential to figure out a marketing/advertising strategy, unless you don’t want your business to grow. To keep up with the modern world of marketing, a business needs to be unique and relevant, have the ability to grab people’s attention, and be memorable.

Now the first thing, when it comes to putting yourself out there for your potential customers to find you, there are a lot of ways in the market that you could go with. You can advertise your business via online ads, flyers, posters, etc.

Those methods may have worked in the past when they were new, but now the internet is spammed with millions of ads, the walls are covered with countless similar-looking posters and most flyers end up in the bin before they reach the decision-maker.

Here’s why online ads and printed advertising fail to attract customers:

  • It’s aggressive; especially online ads. They interrupt the user while they’re watching or browsing something, and instead of being attracted to the ad, the viewers get annoyed by it.
  • Lack of creativity; since all the good ideas for advertising have already been used. It is very hard for designers to come up with an advertising design that has not been done before.
  • Expensive; online ads can be rough on your pocket if the keywords you’re going after are popular.
  • Affects the environment; flyers, posters, etc are made of paper and are of literally no use once they’ve been read.

What’s better?

Considering the type of your business, you could go in several different directions. However, there is one advertising tactic that works for almost all kinds of businesses. What is that? You ask. Vehicle Decals & Lettering.

Vehicle Decals and Lettering:

These are vinyl stickers cut out in a specific design or shape that stick to the surface of your vehicle. Vehicle Decals/Lettering allows you to use your company vehicles/fleet to promote your business.

Why Choose Vehicle Decals and Lettering:

Other than the fact that not a lot of people are aware of this way of promoting their business, here’s why vehicle wraps and decals are better than other types of ads:

  • Non-aggressive; the most important difference that gives lettering & decals the edge is the fact that these ads are not interrupting anything. You’re not forcing people to look at your ad. Therefore, only people who are interested in your ad will look at it.
  • Long-lasting; get decals and forget for years to come. Once done, decals can last for up to 7 years, as long as you go with premium quality material.
  • Eye-catching; the purpose is to get noticed. Being a vehicle with a design or text on it in a bunch of ordinary-looking vehicles is enough to grab people’s attention.

Fresh & Clean – Carpet Cleaning, Pressure Washing and Floor Cleaning | Fleet Vehicle Decals & Lettering:

Our recent client has 3 vehicles that they use to carry out their business duties. Chevrolet Cube Truck, Chevrolet Express 2010, and Ford Transit. The client realized he could be advertising his business via all three vehicles by turning them into moving billboards. So he brought the vehicles to Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s garage.

Our design team worked with the client to design exactly what the client had in his mind. The design was simple yet powerful. The decals show the company logo as well as the contact information in clear bold text. That’s all you need. Always make it easy to read. Because vehicles move fast and people don’t want to spend a lot of time trying to figure something out.

Materials Used:

Vinyl Wrap Toronto always uses premium quality material for wrapping and decals. For Fresh & Clean’s fleet, we used the following materials by Avery Dennison:

  1. Gloss Cardinal Red – SW900-433
  2. Gloss Black – SW900-190

Installation:

It was an easy-to-install job for our expert installers. One thing that clients should be aware of is that it takes a couple of hours to do decals, and the number of hours may increase in the winter because of the temperature.

We’ve attached pictures of the fleet with decals for you to see how ordinary vehicles can become your moving billboards.

If you want to start promoting your business with your fleet, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts regarding vinyl wrap pricing and materials used.

blocks.html:
Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019 | Commercial Van Decals and Lettering

Are you sick and tired of paying for temporary advertisements/promotions? Advertising that is more annoying than interesting to your target market? We have the solution for you right here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. Although nothing in life is permanent, that doesn’t mean there aren’t things that last for years. Anyone who owns a business knows the value of an advertisement that stays for years with a one-time payment. If you’re one of those people, then vehicle wrap/decals are the answer you’re looking for.

Despite the fact that vehicle wraps or lettering & decals last for several years, there are various other advantages. Check out our blog, why you should choose decals and lettering to promote your business. It might surprise most people, but the cost is not always the most important factor.

Our recent client “Power-Wash Equipment Co. Inc.” provides quality washing equipment to its clients and their vision was to be able to show off their brand to reach more potential customers. Upon some research and weighing the pros and cons of various ways to advertise, the client decided to get commercial decals and lettering for his company van Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019.

Designers at Vinyl Wrap Toronto communicated with the client to create a digital mockup of what the decals and lettering would look like on his Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019. We used the customer’s original van as a guide to match colour and fonts. The client approved the design and we started to print and laminate the design. Then the material is passed on to our installers for installation.

Materials Used:

When it comes to our client’s pride and joys, there are to be no compromises with the quality. Vinyl Wrap Toronto only uses premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison and 3M. For this particular job, we used the following vinyl by Avery Dennison:

  • Gloss Soft Red: SW900-427-O LTR EZRS
  • Gloss Dark Blue: SW900-681-O LTR EZRS
  • Gloss Black: SW900-190-O LTR EZRS
  • Gloss White: SW900-101-O LTR EZRS

Being in the industry for years and having wrapped vehicles of all kinds of businesses, it was a fairly straightforward job for our installers to install decals on the client’s Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019.

The client kept it simple and to the point. Here are some of the features of this particular job:

  • Clearly legible.
  • Features a combination of bright colours.
  • Minimal text featuring the services offered by the company.
  • Company’s contact information.
  • Partner logos.

We installed different sized decals and lettering on both sides as well as the back of the Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019. So, the client’s company will be promoted, no matter which direction the person is looking at the van.

We’ve attached pictures of the Ford Transit after the installation of decals and lettering for you to see how you can turn your company vehicle into a canvas that you can use to promote your business.

If you have any questions regarding van lettering & decals, van wrap cost, vinyl wrap installation or any kind of vehicle graphics, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our team members.

blocks.text: Chevy Blazer 2019 Full Vehicle Wrap Colour Change

blocks.alt: Chevy Blazer 2019 - Full Vehicle Wrap - Colour Change - University of Waterloo - VinylWrapToronto.com - Vinyl Wrap Toronto - After - Cover - Avery & 3M Vinyl Wrap

blocks.html:
Chevy Blazer 2019 Colour Change:

When it comes to getting a complete colour change for a vehicle, there can be several reasons. The most typical reasons that encourage people to get a colour change for their vehicle include:

  • The desired colour is not manufactured by the company.
  • The original colour has started to look worn out.
  • The manufacturer doesn’t produce your favourite colour with your desired finish.
  • You want to get a colour that will make the decals pop.

No matter what the reason is, there are two ways you could get a colour change for your vehicle.

  1. Custom Paint Job
  2. A Vinyl Wrap

We’ve already discussed why a vehicle wrap beats getting a custom paint job.

Our recent client “The University of Waterloo” takes part in a competition every year. In the competition, participants are supposed to take a gas-powered car and convert it into a hybrid vehicle. Apart from that, add self-driving technology to the car. How cool is that? The competition is supposed to be a big deal. Chevrolet donates the university one of their vehicle every year to show off decals featuring the sponsors. Usually, the vehicle is white but this year Chevrolet donated a grey Chevy Blazer 2019.

Here’s what the competition is about:

EcoCAR 3: AN ADVANCED VEHICLE TECHNOLOGY COMPETITION, is a four-year collegiate student engineering competition and the only program of its kind. The competition challenges 16 universities across North America to reduce the environmental impact of vehicles without compromising real world performance or safety.

Established by the U.S. Department of Energy and General Motors, and managed by Argonne National Laboratory with support from Natural Resources Canada, EcoCAR 3 succeeds Ecocar 2: Plugging in to the Future and EcoCAR: The NeXt Challenge and features more than a dozen government and industry sponsors.

EcoCAR 3 builds on a proud 26-year history of DOE Advanced Vehicle Technology Competitions that exemplify the power of public/private partnerships in providing invaluable experience and training to promising university students readying to enter the job market.

UWAFT is one of only two Canadian universities competing in EcoCAR 3, making the competition even more of a unique and exciting experience!

Source: University of Waterloo

The students were quick to realize that a grey Chevy Blazer 2019 would not be ideal to show off their sponsors’ decals. So, they contacted Vinyl Wrap Toronto for a complete colour change for the Chevy Blazer 2019.

For the colour change, they decided to go with Avery Dennison’s Gloss Pearl White (SW900-109). It was the ideal choice because the decals would certainly pop on the white background.

Our installers started to wrap the vehicle and since it was a time-sensitive job, we had to do it fast in order to finish on time. When we say fast, we do not compromise with the quality of the wrap. Even though we had some issues with the material, our experienced installers worked it around and delivered a breathtaking colour change job. Having been working in the industry, our installers are well aware of what could go wrong and how to make it work.

Since it was a sponsored job, we did not charge the University of Waterloo any installation fee.

We have attached pictures of the Chevy Blazer 2019 after a complete colour change for you to see how real it looks.

If you have a vehicle that you wish to see in a different colour, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to make it happen. Give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts regarding car wrap cost or vinyl materials. Check out more of our work here.

blocks.html:
Ford Transit 2018 – Commercial Decals and Lettering

When you’re starting a new business or rebranding an existing one, it goes without saying that you need to spread the word. To make sure people know about your business or the changes you’ve made, you need to take every opportunity and put forth your brand for people to see and start recognizing it.

Now, what you don’t want to do is invest in something that annoys people rather than something that efficiently shows off your brand and services.

Having been our long-time returning client, Mr. Takar has seen what kind of advertising works for a business. In the past, we’ve provided Mr. Takar with corporate apparel decorated with his company logo as well as installed promotional decals on his company fleet vehicles. If you’d like to see more van wraps, click here.

To Keep up with the current times and trends, our client decided to rebrand his business from Aeroparks to Aerospot. Changing the name can have a huge impact on a company because the company now has a completely different name. If a business changes its name and does not make an effort to make it known to the general public, it can cause the following:

  • Loss of clients due to the sudden rebranding.
  • May cause the clients to lose faith in the company’s authenticity because it changed names and made no announcement about it.
  • Lose online traffic because people are still searching with the old company name.

To make sure none of the above happens, our client contacted us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto to get promotional decals on two of his fleet vehicles.

Our graphic design team designed the company’s new logo so it made sense to the client that we should be the ones designing custom decals and lettering to show off his rebranded business.

The client wanted the same style and colours for the new decals as he had in the past prior to rebranding his business. Our design team rendered the mockups showing what the decals and lettering would look like on the van.

However, what we see on a screen or paper isn’t necessarily what we get in reality. After we installed the decals on one of the van’s windows the client came in to take a look. He felt the brand name is getting lost or isn’t popping enough to grab someone’s attention due to the glass background. So, we relocated the decals and lettering where they can be clearly seen.

The decals were installed all around the two Ford Transits to make sure they show off the business logo from every direction. We used premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison. The colours the client picked, were:

  • Gloss Orange SW900-373
  • Gloss Dark Blue SW900-681

We’ve attached pictures of the vehicles after getting the promotional decals and lettering for you to see how an ordinary vehicle can be your company’s moving billboard.

Also, check out

  • Benefits of getting decals
  • Tips to get the most out of your promotional company decals

If you are starting a new business or rebranding an existing one, let us spread the word by turning your fleet vehicle into moving billboards. For any questions, or concerns regarding van wrap cost or vinyl materials used, or for a quote, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, On, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our team members. blocks.text: Object Vinyl Wrap: Customize your favourite everyday objects

blocks.alt: Object Wrap - Personalize your Objects with a vinyl wrap - VinylWrapToronto.com - Avery Dennison - Helmet Wrap - 3m Vinyl Wrap

blocks.html:
Object Vinyl Wrap; Make your favourite objects one of a kind

When people hear “Vinyl Wrap Shop” they usually think it’s all about wrapping vehicles and to be honest, that is true for most of the wrap shops out there. However, when a business has been serving clients for years wrapping all kinds of vehicles. No matter big or small, it is not unusual for professionals to start experimenting with something that’s beyond vehicles.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have wrapped cars, motorcycles, trucks, boats, motor homes, vans and everything in between. So, it made sense that our designers and installers wanted to push their limits and wrap objects. We all have objects that we use on a regular basis that could use a personalized touch. The problem however is the fact that there aren’t a lot of options out there.

In most cases, to personalize an object people just go for mass-produced stickers or decals, but that’s not unique and personal. And the manufacturers only produce stickers that they know are desired by a large audience such as something related to viral trends on the internet.

Now, what about the people who possess a unique sense of taste? There are few to no choices. This is why we started to wrap objects for our clients who wanted to personalize their favourite objects.

Over the years, we’ve wrapped the following objects for our clients:

1. High Heels:

Now you must be wondering, how would someone customize a pair of heels with a vinyl wrap? Well, that wasn’t an issue for our genius designers to come up with an idea that turns an ordinary pair of heels into a work of art. Here’s what the heels look like after a touch of some vinyl goodness.

2. Guitars:

Let’s be honest. We all know someone who has a guitar lying around the house even if they don’t know how to play it. Some people just do it for the sole purpose of decoration. One of our clients wanted to take it to the next level by customizing the guitar with their favourite TV show characters from the popular animated comedy series “The Simpsons”. Our team took the opportunity to come up with a unique style based on the instructions given by the client. Here’s how it turned out. See more pictures of the guitar here.

3. Laptops/Macbooks:

For laptops, you can find thousands of skins on the market with various designs. But the problem again is that those designs are the ones that are carefully chosen for a large audience. For our client who works as a DJ, nothing on the market matched his vision. So, he contacted us and got a custom-designed object wrap for his laptop.

4. Tables:

Tables usually do not come in a lot of designs and colours. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we saw it as an opportunity to do something unique. ANd here’s what it ended up looking like.

5. Helmets:

When you know you’re going to be wearing a helmet, you might as well want to wear the one that looks the coolest among all others. We have wrapped helmets for our clients with their favourite graphics. A goalie’s helmet and a recent client’s helmet who goes go-karting.

6. iPhones/Mobile Phones:

One of the things that everyone uses is an iPhone or an Android smartphone. While there are thousands of phone cases on the market, A) They’re not personalized and unique. B) They’re bulky and add unwanted weight to your phone. Consider getting a vinyl wrap on your phone for all-around protection with the ability to have any design that you like. You can even add QR codes to your social media channels, website, or basically any design that you can imagine.

7. And more:

Apart from the things mentioned above, we dipped our toe into wrapping walls, windows, cabinets, chimneys, and the list keeps growing. Our motto is, we can wrap anything as long as it has a solid surface.

If you have a unique object that you wish to give a personal touch on or wish to learn more about vinyl wrap cost, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our professionals. Check out more of our equipment wraps here.

blocks.html:
Ford Transit 2020 Commercial Vehicle Wrap

Having a business automatically turns you into a marketer or at least someone who tries to be one. You find yourself getting intrigued by new ideas and think about how you can use those ideas to take your business to the next level. You look for opportunities that promise growth at an affordable price.

Do you relate to any of it? We’ve got an idea for you that promises long-term advertising for a one-time payment. That is Promotional Vehicle Wraps. If there’s something that offers complete freedom of design and durability, it is vehicle wraps. The benefits of getting a commercial van wrap are just too good for the price.
